##### Growing Ferocity {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.boren/growing-ferocity"}

As your ferocity grows, you gain benefits as noted on the [Boren](../../Browse/kit/boren.md) [Growing Ferocity](../../Browse/feature/fury/boren/growing-ferocity.md) table. Benefits are cumulative except where an improved benefit replaces a lesser benefit.

###### Boren Growing Ferocity Table

| Ferocity        | Benefit                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|-----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 2               | You can have up to two creatures [grabbed](../../Browse/condition/grabbed.md) at a time. Additionally, whenever you make a [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) against a creature you have [grabbed](../../Browse/condition/grabbed.md), you gain 1 [surge](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md).                                                                       |
| 4               | The first time you grab a creature on a [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), you gain 1 [surge](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md).                                                                                                                                                           |

| 10 (7th level)  | You have a double [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on the [Grab](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/grab.md) and [Knockback](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/knockback.md) maneuvers.                                                                                                                                                               |
| 12 (10th level) | Whenever you use a [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md), you gain 10 [temporary Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina.md). Additionally, whenever you have a creature [grabbed](../../Browse/condition/grabbed.md), any [ability roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/ability-roll.md) made against that creature gains a [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to its [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) equal to your [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md) score. |

#### Corven {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/kit/corven"}

With this stormwight kit, you channel your [primordial ferocity](../../Browse/feature/fury/level-10/primordial-ferocity.md) into the form of a crow, becoming stealthy and quick. [Corven](../../Browse/kit/corven.md) are tied to the mountain passes and the hot winds that flow through them. This aspect is associated with the warm and fast-rising anabatic wind.

##### Aspect Benefits {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.corven/aspect-benefits"}

You gain an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on [tests](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md) made to hide and sneak. Additionally, whenever you fall, you can use a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) to use your [Aspect of the Wild](../../Browse/feature/ability/fury/stormwight-kits/aspect-of-the-wild.md) ability.

##### Animal Form: Crow {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.corven/animal-form-crow"}

While you are in your crow form, your [size](../../Browse/rule/character/size.md) is 1T and you can [fly](../../Browse/movement/fly.md). You can use the [Hide](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/hide.md) maneuver as a [free maneuver](../../Browse/rule/combat/free-maneuver.md), and you can use your allies as [cover](../../Browse/rule/combat/cover.md) when you hide. You can't use any abilities while in this form except for [Aspect of the Wild](../../Browse/feature/ability/fury/stormwight-kits/aspect-of-the-wild.md).

##### Hybrid Form: Crow {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.corven/hybrid-form-crow"}

While you are in your hybrid form, your [size](../../Browse/rule/character/size.md) is your choice of 1S or 1M. At 4th level, you can [fly](../../Browse/movement/fly.md).

##### Primordial Storm: Anabatic Wind {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.corven/primordial-storm-anabatic-wind"}

Your primordial [damage type](../../Browse/rule/damage/damage-type.md) is fire.

##### Kit Bonuses {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.corven/kit-bonuses"}

- **[Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) [Bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md):** +3 per [echelon](../../Browse/rule/general/echelon.md)
- **[Speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) [Bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md):** +3
- **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) Damage [Bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md):** +2/+2/+2

#### Raden {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/kit/raden"}

With this stormwight kit, you channel your [primordial ferocity](../../Browse/feature/fury/level-10/primordial-ferocity.md) into the form of a rat, becoming mobile and elusive. [Raden](../../Browse/kit/raden.md) are associated with the wild nature of the rat, before cities became their habitat. This aspect is associated with the rat flood—a surge of corrupted water that draws forth hordes of rats.

##### Aspect Benefits {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.raden/aspect-benefits"}

You gain an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on [tests](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md) made to hide and sneak. Additionally, you ignore [difficult terrain](../../Browse/movement/difficult-terrain.md).

##### Animal Form: Rat {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.raden/animal-form-rat"}

While you are in your rat form, your [size](../../Browse/rule/character/size.md) is 1T and you can automatically climb at full [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) while moving. You can use the [Hide](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/hide.md) maneuver as a [free maneuver](../../Browse/rule/combat/free-maneuver.md), you can use your allies as [cover](../../Browse/rule/combat/cover.md) when you hide, and you can stay hidden while you move through squares occupied by any creature. Additionally, you gain an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on [tests](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md) made to climb other creatures. You can't use any abilities while in this form except for [Aspect of the Wild](../../Browse/feature/ability/fury/stormwight-kits/aspect-of-the-wild.md).

##### Hybrid Form: Rat {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.raden/hybrid-form-rat"}

While you are in your hybrid form, your [size](../../Browse/rule/character/size.md) is your choice of 1S or 1M. At 4th level, you can automatically climb at full [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) while moving.

##### Primordial Storm: Rat Flood {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.raden/primordial-storm-rat-flood"}

Your primordial [damage type](../../Browse/rule/damage/damage-type.md) is corruption.

## Null {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/class/null"}

The mind is not separate from the body. Perfection of one requires perfection of the other. You strive for perfect discipline, perfect order, mastery over mind and body, becoming an unarmed psionic warrior who dampens and absorbs magic and psionics. You require no weapons, no tools. You suffice.

**As a [null](../../Browse/class/null.md), you resist the [supernatural](../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural.md) forces of the universe with composure and confidence. As you strive for perfect order, you are an enemy of the ultimate expression of chaos: the [supernatural](../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural.md). Those who break the laws of nature using sorcery or psionics should fear you.**

> "Any weapon can be turned against the hand that wields it."
>
> **Ardashir**

### Basics

**Starting [Characteristics](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md):** You start with an [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md) of 2 and an [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) of 2, and you can choose one of the following arrays for your other [characteristic](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md) scores:

- 2, −1, −1
- 1, 1, −1
- 1, 0, 0

**Weak [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) − 2

**Average [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) − 1

**Strong [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md)

**Starting [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) at 1st Level:** 21

**[Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) Gained at 2nd and Higher Levels:** 9

**[Recoveries](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md):** 8

**Skills:** You gain the [Psionics](../../Browse/skill/lore/psionics.md) skill (see Skills in Chapter 9: [Tests](tests.md)). Then choose any two skills from the [interpersonal](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/interpersonal.md) or [lore](../../Browse/skill/lore/lore.md) skill groups. (*Quick Build:* Psionics, [Read Person](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/read-person.md), Timescape.)

### 1st-Level Features

As a 1st-level [null](../../Browse/class/null.md), you gain the following features.

#### Null Tradition {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/null-tradition"}

Through extensive physical and psionic training, you have learned to unlock the full potential of your body. As you shape the growth of your power, you choose a [null tradition](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-tradition.md) from the following options, each of which grants you a skill. (*Quick Build:* Chronokinetic and the [Monsters](../../Browse/skill/lore/monsters.md) skill.)

- **Chronokinetic:** Your training unmoors you from temporal reality, allowing you to use the flow of time as another dimension that all things move through. You gain one skill from the [lore group](../../Browse/skill/lore/lore.md).
- **Cryokinetic:** You can tap into absolute cold, the most essential energy of myriad manifolds, and manifest its effects in your body. You gain one skill from the [crafting group](../../Browse/skill/crafting/crafting.md).
- **Metakinetic:** You learn to see through the illusions of the universe to more fully understand your body and its psionic potential. You gain one skill from the [exploration group](../../Browse/skill/exploration/exploration.md).

Your [null tradition](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-tradition.md) is your [subclass](../../Browse/rule/general/subclass.md), and your choice of tradition determines many of the features you'll gain as you gain new levels.

#### Discipline {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/discipline"}

As your mastery of your body and tradition grows, it imbues you with a [Heroic Resource](../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource.md) called discipline.

##### Discipline in Combat

At the start of a combat encounter or some other stressful situation tracked in [combat rounds](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) (as determined by the Director), you gain discipline equal to your [Victories](../../Browse/rule/resource/victories.md). At the start of each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) during combat, you gain 2 discipline.

Additionally, the first time each [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) that an enemy in the area of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability (see below) uses a main action, you gain 1 discipline. The first time each [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) that the Director uses an ability that costs Malice (see *Draw Steel: Monsters*), you gain 1 discipline.

You lose any remaining discipline at the end of the encounter.

##### Discipline Outside of Combat

Though you can't gain discipline outside of combat, you can use your [heroic abilities](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) and effects that cost discipline without spending it. Whenever you use an ability or effect outside of combat that costs discipline, you can't use that same ability or effect outside of combat again until you earn 1 or more [Victories](../../Browse/rule/resource/victories.md) or finish a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md).

When you use an ability outside of combat that lets you spend unlimited discipline on its effect, you can use it as if you had spent an amount of discipline equal to your [Victories](../../Browse/rule/resource/victories.md). (Such abilities aren't part of the core rules for the [null](../../Browse/class/null.md), but they might appear in future products.)

#### Null Field {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/null-field"}

You project a psionic field of order around your body, dampening the effects of [supernatural](../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural.md) abilities harmful to you and your allies.

##### Null Field {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-1/null-field"}


*You project an [aura](../../Browse/rule/combat/aura.md) that dampens the power of your foes.*

| **Area, Psionic** |                  **Maneuver** |
|-------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 1 [aura](../../Browse/rule/combat/aura.md)**     | **🎯 Each enemy in the area** |

**Effect:** Each target reduces their [potencies](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) by 1.

Once as a [free maneuver](../../Browse/rule/combat/free-maneuver.md) on each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), you can spend 1 discipline and give your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) one of the following additional effects until the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md):

- Gravitic Disruption: The first time on a [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) that a target takes damage, you can [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) them up to 2 squares.
- Inertial Anchor: Any target who starts their [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) in the area can't [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md).
- Synaptic Break: Whenever you or any ally uses an ability against a target that has a [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) effect, the [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) is increased by 1.

This ability remains active even after an encounter ends. It ends only if you are [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md) or if you willingly end it (no action required).

#### Inertial Shield {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/inertial-shield"}

Your instincts for danger let you predict attacks before they happen.

##### Inertial Shield {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-1/inertial-shield"}


*You intuit the course of an incoming attack, reducing its effects.*

| **Psionic** | **Triggered** |
|-------------|--------------:|
| **📏 Self** |   **🎯 Self** |

**Trigger:** You take damage.

**Effect:** You take half the damage.

**Spend 1 Discipline:** The [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) of one effect associated with the damage is reduced by 1 for you.

#### Discipline Mastery {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/discipline-mastery"}

As you advance in your chosen [null tradition](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-tradition.md), you gain certain benefits in combat, including benefits based on the amount of discipline you have. Benefits based on how much discipline you have last until the end of your [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), even if a benefit would become unavailable to you because of the amount of discipline you spend during your [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

Some [Discipline Mastery](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/discipline-mastery.md) benefits can be applied only if you are a specific level or higher, with the level of those benefits noted in the tables below.

##### Chronokinetic Mastery {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/chronokinetic-mastery"}

Whenever you use the [Inertial Shield](../../Browse/feature/ability/null/level-1/inertial-shield.md) ability, you can use the [Disengage](../../Browse/feature/common/move-actions/disengage.md) move action as a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md).

Additionally, as your discipline grows, your psionic mastery of your body intensifies, granting benefits from the [Chronokinetic Mastery](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/chronokinetic-mastery.md) table. Benefits are cumulative except where an improved benefit replaces a lesser benefit.

###### Chronokinetic Mastery Table

| Discipline      | Benefit                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|-----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 2               | Whenever you use the [Knockback](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/knockback.md) maneuver, you can use the [Disengage](../../Browse/feature/common/move-actions/disengage.md) move action as a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) either before or after the maneuver.                                              |
| 4               | The first time on a [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) that you willingly move 1 or more squares as part of an ability, you gain 1 [surge](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md).                                                                                 |
| 6               | You gain an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on the [Grab](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/grab.md) and [Knockback](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/knockback.md) maneuvers.                                                                                                                                       |
| 8 (4th level)   | The first time on a [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) that you willingly move 1 or more squares as part of an ability, you gain 2 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md).                                                                                |
| 10 (7th level)  | You have a double [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on the [Grab](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/grab.md) and [Knockback](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/knockback.md) maneuvers.                                                                                                                                 |
| 12 (10th level) | Whenever you force move a target, the [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) gains a [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score. Additionally, whenever you use a [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md), you gain 10 [temporary Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina.md). |

#### Null Speed {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/null-speed"}

The flow of psionic power through you allows you to achieve high velocity. You gain a [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) and to the number of squares you can [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) when you take the [Disengage](../../Browse/feature/common/move-actions/disengage.md) move action equal to your [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md) score.

#### Psionic Augmentation {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/psionic-augmentation"}

Your training has turned your body into the perfect psionic weapon, shaping pathways in your mind that enhance your physical form. Choose one of the following augmentations. You can change your augmentation by undergoing a psionic meditation as a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md) activity. (*Quick Build:* [Speed Augmentation](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/speed-augmentation.md).)

##### Density Augmentation {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/density-augmentation"}

You gain a +6 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md), and this [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) increases by 6 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels. Additionally, you gain a +1 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [stability](../../Browse/rule/character/stability.md).

##### Force Augmentation {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/force-augmentation"}

Your damage-dealing psionic abilities gain a +1 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [rolled damage](../../Browse/rule/damage/rolled-damage.md).

##### Speed Augmentation {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/speed-augmentation"}

You gain a +1 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) and to the [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) you can [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) when you take the [Disengage](../../Browse/feature/common/move-actions/disengage.md) move action.

#### Psionic Martial Arts {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/psionic-martial-arts"}

Whenever you use the [Knockback](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/knockback.md) or [Grab](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/grab.md) maneuver, you use [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) instead of [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md) for the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) and for determining if you can target creatures larger than you. Additionally, whenever you use the [Knockback](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/knockback.md) maneuver, you can choose to [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) the target instead of [pushing](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) them.

#### Null Abilities {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/null-abilities"}

You rely on a unique blend of martial techniques and psionic prowess to take down your foes and defend your allies.

##### Signature Abilities

Choose two [signature abilities](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) from the following options. [Signature abilities](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) can be used at will. (*Quick Build:* [Faster Than the Eye](../../Browse/feature/ability/null/level-1/faster-than-the-eye.md), [Inertial Step](../../Browse/feature/ability/null/level-1/inertial-step.md).)

###### Dance of Blows {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-1/dance-of-blows"}


*You strike everywhere at once, tricking an enemy into moving out of position.*

| **Area, Psionic, Weapon** |               **Main action** |
|---------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 1 [burst](../../Browse/rule/combat/burst.md)**            | **🎯 Each enemy in the area** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md):**

- **≤11:** 3 damage
- **12-16:** 4 damage
- **17+:** 5 damage

**Effect:** You can [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) one [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) enemy up to a number of squares equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score.

###### Faster Than the Eye {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-1/faster-than-the-eye"}


*You strike so quickly that your hands become a blur.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), Psionic, [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |                 **Main action** |
|------------------------------------|--------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1**                     | **🎯 Two creatures or objects** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md):**

- **≤11:** 4 damage
- **12-16:** 5 damage
- **17+:** 7 damage

**Effect:** You can deal damage equal to your [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md) score to one creature or object [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) to you.

###### Inertial Step {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-1/inertial-step"}


*You flit about the battlefield and take an opportunistic strike.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), Psionic, [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |               **Main action** |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------:|

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md):**

- **12-16:** 7 + A damage
- **17+:** 10 + A damage

**Effect:** You can [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) up to half your [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) before or after you make this [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md).

- **17+:** 6 + A damage; [taunted](../../Browse/condition/taunted.md) ([EoT](../../Browse/rule/combat/end-of-turn.md)), [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 2

**Effect:** Each target takes psychic damage equal to twice your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score. Until the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), the size of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability increases by 1. At the end of your current [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), each enemy in the area of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability takes psychic damage equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score.

###### Relentless Nemesis {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-1/relentless-nemesis"}


*You strike, and for the next few moments, your enemy can't escape you.*

|------------------------------------|------------------------------:|

- **12-16:** 8 + A damage

You must end this [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) to the target.

|------------------------------------|------------------------------:|

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md):**

- **17+:** 7 + A damage; I < STRONG, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) and [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends)

### 2nd-Level Features

As a 2nd-level [null](../../Browse/class/null.md), you gain the following features.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-2/perk"}

You gain one exploration, interpersonal, or intrigue perk of your choice. See Chapter 7: [Perks](perks.md).

#### 2nd-Level Tradition Feature {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-2/2nd-level-tradition-feature"}

Your [null tradition](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-tradition.md) grants you a feature, as shown on the 2nd-Level Tradition Features table.

###### 2nd-Level Tradition Features Table

| Tradition     | Feature               |
|---------------|-----------------------|
| Chronokinetic | [Rapid Processing](../../Browse/feature/null/level-2/rapid-processing.md)      |
| Cryokinetic   | [Entropic Adaptability](../../Browse/feature/null/level-2/entropic-adaptability.md) |
| Metakinetic   | [Inertial Sink](../../Browse/feature/null/level-2/inertial-sink.md)         |

##### Entropic Adaptability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-2/entropic-adaptability"}

You have cold immunity equal to twice your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score. Additionally, you ignore [difficult terrain](../../Browse/movement/difficult-terrain.md) related to cold and ice, and you can automatically climb at full [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) while moving.

##### Inertial Sink {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-2/inertial-sink"}

You add your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score to your effective [size](../../Browse/rule/character/size.md) for the purpose of interacting with creatures and objects, such as for determining whether you can lift an object, whether you are affected by [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md), and so forth. This has no effect on whether you can be [grabbed](../../Browse/condition/grabbed.md).

Additionally, when you fall, you reduce the effective height of the fall by 5 squares in addition to any other reductions. Whenever you take damage from being [force moved](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md), you reduce that damage by an amount equal to your level.

##### Rapid Processing {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-2/rapid-processing"}

As a maneuver, you can read an entire book or process a similar amount of information. Additionally, during any [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md), you can take an additional [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md) activity.

#### 2nd-Level Tradition Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-2/2nd-level-tradition-ability"}

Your [null tradition](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-tradition.md) grants your choice of one of two abilities.

### 3rd-Level Features

As a 3rd-level [null](../../Browse/class/null.md), you gain the following features.

#### Psionic Leap {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-3/psionic-leap"}

You can long jump and high jump a [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) equal to twice your [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md) score without needing to make a [test](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md).

#### Reorder {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-3/reorder"}

At the start of each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), you can use a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) to end one effect on you that is ended by a [saving throw](../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw.md) or that ends at the end of your [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md). Alternatively, you can grant this benefit to one creature in the area of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability.

#### 7-Discipline Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-3/7-discipline-ability"}

Choose one [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) from the following options, each of which costs 7 discipline to use.

##### Absorption Field {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-3/absorption-field"}


*Your [null field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) absorbs kinetic energy.*

| **Psionic** | **Maneuver** |
|-------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self** |  **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** Until the end of the encounter, the size of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability increases by 1. While the area of that ability is enlarged this way, each enemy in the area takes a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on [ability rolls](../../Browse/rule/dice/ability-roll.md).

##### Molecular Rearrangement Field {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-3/molecular-rearrangement-field"}


*Your enemies' wounds open, your allies' wounds close.*

| **Psionic** | **Maneuver** |
|-------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self** |  **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** Until the end of the encounter, the size of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability increases by 1. While the area of that ability is enlarged this way, each enemy who has I < AVERAGE and enters the area for the first time in a [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) or starts their turn there is [bleeding](../../Browse/condition/bleeding.md) (save ends). Each ally who enters the area for the first time in a [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) or starts their turn there gains [temporary Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina.md) equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score.

##### Stabilizing Field {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-3/stabilizing-field"}


*You project order, making it harder for your enemies to interfere with you and your allies.*

| **Psionic** | **Maneuver** |
|-------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self** |  **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** Until the end of the encounter, the size of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability increases by 1. While the area of that ability is enlarged this way, you ignore [difficult terrain](../../Browse/movement/difficult-terrain.md) and reduce the [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) of enemy effects targeting you by 1 for you. You can also use a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) at the start of each of your turns to end one effect on you that is ended by a [saving throw](../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw.md) or that ends at the end of your [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md). Each ally in the area also gains these benefits.

##### Synapse Field {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-3/synapse-field"}


*Attacks made by allies in your [null field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) disrupt your enemies' thoughts, causing psychic pain.*

| **Psionic** | **Maneuver** |
|-------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self** |  **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** Until the end of the encounter, the size of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability increases by 1. While the area of that ability is enlarged this way, whenever an enemy in the area takes [rolled damage](../../Browse/rule/damage/rolled-damage.md), they take extra psychic damage equal to twice your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score.

### 4th-Level Features

As a 4th-level [null](../../Browse/class/null.md), you gain the following features.

#### Characteristic Increase {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-4/characteristic-increase"}

Your [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md) and [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) scores each increase to 3.

#### Discipline Mastery Improvement {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-4/discipline-mastery-improvement"}

Your [Discipline Mastery](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/discipline-mastery.md) feature provides additional benefits when you have 8 or more discipline.

#### Enhanced Null Field {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-4/enhanced-null-field"}

While using your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability, you disrupt magic and psionic power suffusing the area around you. During combat, any temporary [supernatural](../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural.md) terrain effects of your level or lower are removed when your [aura](../../Browse/rule/combat/aura.md) partially or fully overlaps with their location. Permanent [supernatural](../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural.md) terrain effects of your level or lower are temporarily negated while your [aura](../../Browse/rule/combat/aura.md) overlaps with their location, but return when the [aura](../../Browse/rule/combat/aura.md) no longer overlaps with them.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-4/perk"}

You gain one perk of your choice.

#### Regenerative Field {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-4/regenerative-field"}

The first time each [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) that an enemy in the area of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability uses a main action, you gain 2 discipline instead of 1.

#### Skill {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-4/skill"}

You gain one skill of your choice. See Skills in Chapter 9: [Tests](tests.md).

### 5th-Level Features

As a 5th-level [null](../../Browse/class/null.md), you gain the following features.

#### 5th-Level Tradition Feature {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-5/5th-level-tradition-feature"}

Your [null tradition](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-tradition.md) grants you a feature, as shown on the 5th-Level Tradition Features table.

###### 5th-Level Tradition Features Table

| Tradition     | Feature            |
|---------------|--------------------|
| Chronokinetic | [Instant Action](../../Browse/feature/null/level-5/instant-action.md)     |
| Cryokinetic   | [Chilling Readiness](../../Browse/feature/null/level-5/chilling-readiness.md) |
| Metakinetic   | [Inertial Fulcrum](../../Browse/feature/null/level-5/inertial-fulcrum.md)   |

#### Chilling Readiness {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-5/chilling-readiness"}

You steel yourself for imminent danger by tapping into your body's cold energy. At the start of any combat, you gain a number of [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md) equal to your [Victories](../../Browse/rule/resource/victories.md).

#### Inertial Fulcrum {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-5/inertial-fulcrum"}

Whenever you use an ability to reduce damage dealt to you or to reduce the [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) of [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) imposed upon you, you can deal damage to one enemy in the area of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score.

#### Instant Action {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-5/instant-action"}

If you're not [surprised](../../Browse/rule/combat/surprised.md) at the start of your first [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) in combat, you gain an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on [ability rolls](../../Browse/rule/dice/ability-roll.md) and gain 2 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md). If you are [surprised](../../Browse/rule/combat/surprised.md), you can spend 3 discipline to no longer be [surprised](../../Browse/rule/combat/surprised.md) and gain the benefits of this feature.

#### 9-Discipline Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-5/9-discipline-ability"}

Choose one [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) from the following options, each of which costs 9 discipline to use.

##### Anticipating Strike {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-5/anticipating-strike"}


*You suddenly strike an enemy, then grab them in a psionically enhanced grip.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), Psionic, [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |  **Free triggered** |
|------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1**                     | **🎯 One creature** |

**Trigger:** The target moves or uses a main action.

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md):**

- **≤11:** 7 + A damage; I < WEAK, [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) (save ends)
- **12-16:** 10 + A damage; I < AVERAGE, [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) (save ends)
- **17+:** 13 + A damage; I < STRONG, [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) (save ends)

**Effect:** This [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) resolves before the triggering movement or main action.

##### Iron Grip {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-5/iron-grip"}


*You grab the target with [supernatural](../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural.md) force.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), Psionic, [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |     **Main action** |
|------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1**                     | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md):**

- **≤11:** 10 + A damage; A < WEAK, [grabbed](../../Browse/condition/grabbed.md)
- **12-16:** 14 + A damage; A < AVERAGE, [grabbed](../../Browse/condition/grabbed.md)
- **17+:** 18 + A damage; A < STRONG, [grabbed](../../Browse/condition/grabbed.md)

**Effect:** While [grabbed](../../Browse/condition/grabbed.md) this way, the target takes a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on the [Escape Grab](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/escape-grab.md) maneuver. Each time they use that maneuver, they take damage equal to twice your [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md) score.

##### Phase Leap {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-5/phase-leap"}


*You leap beyond reality, leaving an afterimage of yourself.*

| **Psionic** |    **Move** |
|-------------|------------:|
| **📏 Self** | **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** You jump up to your [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) without provoking [opportunity attacks](../../Browse/rule/combat/opportunity-attack.md). Until the end of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), a static afterimage of you remains in the space you left, and any enemy [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) to your afterimage takes a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on [ability rolls](../../Browse/rule/dice/ability-roll.md). You can use your abilities from your own space or from the space of your afterimage as if you were still there. Additionally, if your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability is active, your afterimage also projects the [aura](../../Browse/rule/combat/aura.md) from that ability, which you control as if you were in the afterimage's space.

##### Synaptic Reset {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-5/synaptic-reset"}


*You expand your nullifying power to mitigate harmful effects.*

| **Area, Psionic** |                          **Maneuver** |
|-------------------|--------------------------------------:|
| **📏 3 [burst](../../Browse/rule/combat/burst.md)**    | **🎯 Self and each ally in the area** |

**Effect:** Each target can end any [conditions](../../Browse/rule/combat/condition.md) or effects on themself, and gains 5 [temporary Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina.md) for each [condition](../../Browse/rule/combat/condition.md) or effect removed.

### 6th-Level Features

As a 6th-level [null](../../Browse/class/null.md), you gain the following features.

#### Elemental Absorption {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-6/elemental-absorption"}

Whenever you use your [Inertial Shield](../../Browse/feature/ability/null/level-1/inertial-shield.md) [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md), you gain immunity to acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, and sonic damage equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score against the triggering damage.

#### Elemental Buffer {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-6/elemental-buffer"}

Whenever you reduce acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic damage with [damage immunity](../../Browse/rule/damage/damage-immunity.md), you gain 2 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md) that can be used only to increase the damage of your next strike.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-6/perk"}

You gain one exploration, interpersonal, or intrigue perk of your choice.

#### 6th-Level Tradition Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-6/6th-level-tradition-ability"}

Your [null tradition](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-tradition.md) grants your choice of one of two [heroic abilities](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md).

##### 6th-Level Chronokinetic Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Interphase {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-6/interphase"}


*You slip into a faster timestream to act more quickly.*

| **Psionic** | **Main action** |
|-------------|----------------:|
| **📏 Self** |     **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** You can use up to three [signature abilities](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md), each of which gains an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md).

###### Phase Step {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-6/phase-step"}


*You weaken your connection to this manifold, allowing you to move through and damage enemies.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), Psionic, Weapon** | **Main action** |
|----------------------------|----------------:|
| **📏 Self; see below**     |     **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** You can [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) up to your [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md), and squares occupied by enemies or objects are not [difficult terrain](../../Browse/movement/difficult-terrain.md) for this [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md). You make one [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) that targets each enemy you moved through during this [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md).

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md):**

- **≤11:** 6 damage; M < WEAK, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md)
- **12-16:** 8 damage; M < AVERAGE, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md)
- **17+:** 12 damage; M < STRONG, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md)

##### 6th-Level Cryokinetic Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Ice Pillars {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-6/ice-pillars"}


*Pillars of ice erupt from the ground and launch your foes into the air.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |                   **Main action** |
|---------------------|----------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**    | **🎯 Three creatures or objects** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md):**

- **≤11:** Vertical [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 6
- **12-16:** Vertical [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 8
- **17+:** Vertical [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 10

**Effect:** The pillars vanish as soon as the effects of the [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) are resolved.

###### Wall of Ice {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-6/wall-of-ice"}


*You create a [wall of ice](../../Browse/feature/ability/null/level-6/wall-of-ice.md).*

| **Area, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** | **Main action** |
|---------------------------|----------------:|
| **📏 10 wall within 10**  |  **🎯 Special** |

**Effect:** You can place this wall in occupied squares, [sliding](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) each creature in the area into the nearest unoccupied space of your choice. The wall remains until the end of the encounter or until you are [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md). The wall's squares are treated as stone squares for the purpose of damage, and you and allies can move freely through the wall. Each enemy who enters a square [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) to the wall and has M < AVERAGE is [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends). Each enemy who is [force moved](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) into the wall and has M < AVERAGE is [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) (save ends).

##### 6th-Level Metakinetic Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Gravitic Charge {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-6/gravitic-charge"}


*You channel your discipline into momentum that defies gravity.*

| **Psionic** | **Maneuver** |
|-------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self** |  **🎯 Self** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md):**

- **≤11:** Vertical [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 5
- **12-16:** Vertical [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 7
- **17+:** Vertical [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 9

**Effect:** This movement ignores [stability](../../Browse/rule/character/stability.md). If you [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) into another creature, you resolve damage to both of you as if your [force move](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md)ment had ended, but you keep moving through that creature's space.

###### Iron Body {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-6/iron-body"}


*You focus until your body becomes as hard as iron.*

| **Psionic** | **Maneuver** |
|-------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self** |  **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** You gain 20 [temporary Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina.md). Additionally, until the end of the encounter, your [stability](../../Browse/rule/character/stability.md) gains a [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score.

### 7th-Level Features

As a 7th-level [null](../../Browse/class/null.md), you gain the following features.

#### Characteristic Increase {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-7/characteristic-increase"}

Each of your [characteristic](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md) scores increases by 1, to a maximum of 4.

#### Discipline Mastery Improvement {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-7/discipline-mastery-improvement"}

Your [Discipline Mastery](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/discipline-mastery.md) feature provides additional benefits when you have 10 or more discipline.

#### Psi Boost {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-7/psi-boost"}

Whenever you use an ability that is a main action or a maneuver with the Psionic keyword, you can spend additional discipline to apply a [psi boost](../../Browse/feature/null/level-7/psi-boost.md) to it and enhance its effects. A [psi boost](../../Browse/feature/null/level-7/psi-boost.md)'s effects only last until the end of the [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) which the ability is first used. You can apply multiple psi boosts to an ability, but only one instance of each specific boost. You can use the following psi boosts.

##### Dynamic Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-7/dynamic-power"}

If the ability force moves a target, the [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) gains a [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score.

##### Expanded Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-7/expanded-power"}

If the ability targets an area, you increase the size of the area by 1. If the area is a line, you increase the size of one dimension, not both.

##### Extended Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-7/extended-power"}

If the ability is [ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), the [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) gains a [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score. If the ability is [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), the [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) gains a +2 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md).

##### Heightened Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-7/heightened-power"}

If the ability deals [rolled damage](../../Browse/rule/damage/rolled-damage.md), it deals extra damage equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score.

##### Magnified Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-7/magnified-power"}

If the ability has a [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md), you increase that [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) by an amount equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score.

##### Shared Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-7/shared-power"}

If the ability targets individual creatures or objects, you target one additional creature or object within [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md).

##### Sharpened Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-7/sharpened-power"}

If the ability has any [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md), that roll gains an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md).

#### Improved Body {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-7/improved-body"}

When you gain discipline at the start of each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) during combat, you gain 3 discipline instead of 2.

#### Skill {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-7/skill"}

You gain one skill of your choice.

### 8th-Level Features

As an 8th-level [null](../../Browse/class/null.md), you gain the following features.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-8/perk"}

You gain one perk of your choice.

#### 8th-Level Tradition Feature {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-8/8th-level-tradition-feature"}

Your [null tradition](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-tradition.md) grants you a feature, as shown on the 8th-Level Tradition Features table.

###### 8th-Level Tradition Features Table

| Tradition     | Feature           |
|---------------|-------------------|
| Chronokinetic | [Shared Momentum](../../Browse/feature/null/level-8/shared-momentum.md)   |
| Cryokinetic   | [Synaptic Triage](../../Browse/feature/null/level-8/synaptic-triage.md)   |
| Metakinetic   | [Inertial Dampener](../../Browse/feature/null/level-8/inertial-dampener.md) |

##### Inertial Dampener {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-8/inertial-dampener"}

You and each creature or object of your choice in the area of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability gain a [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [stability](../../Browse/rule/character/stability.md) equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score. A creature who attempts to [force move](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) a target with this [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) takes psychic damage equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score.

##### Shared Momentum {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-8/shared-momentum"}

When you take the [Disengage](../../Browse/feature/common/move-actions/disengage.md) move action, one ally in the area of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability can also take the [Disengage](../../Browse/feature/common/move-actions/disengage.md) move action as a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md), using your [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) for that move action.

##### Synaptic Triage {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-8/synaptic-triage"}

As a [free maneuver](../../Browse/rule/combat/free-maneuver.md), you can spend 1d6 [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) to remove one effect on you. Each creature of your choice in the area of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability also gains this benefit.

#### 11-Discipline Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-8/11-discipline-ability"}

Choose one [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) from the following options, each of which costs 11 discipline to use.

##### Arcane Purge {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-8/arcane-purge"}


*You focus your [null field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) into a pressure point strike that prevents your foe from channeling sorcery.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), Psionic, [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |     **Main action** |
|------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1**                     | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md):**

- **≤11:** 13 + A damage; M < WEAK, the target is suppressed (save ends)
- **12-16:** 19 + A damage; M < AVERAGE, the target is suppressed (save ends)
- **17+:** 24 + A damage; M < STRONG, the target is suppressed (save ends)

**Effect:** While suppressed, a target takes psychic damage equal to twice your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score at the start of their [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), whenever they use a [supernatural](../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural.md) ability, or whenever they use an ability that costs Malice.

##### Phase Hurl {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-8/phase-hurl"}


*You throw your foe out of phase with this manifold, causing them to harm other enemies as they return.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), Psionic, [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |     **Main action** |
|------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1**                     | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md):**

- **≤11:** 9 + A damage; [push](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 5; I < WEAK, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends)
- **12-16:** 13 + A damage; [push](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 7; I < AVERAGE, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends)
- **17+:** 18 + A damage; [push](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 10; I < STRONG, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends)

**Effect:** The target and each creature or object they collide with from this [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) takes psychic damage equal to the total number of squares the target was force moved. While the target is [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) this way, they see glimpses of creatures from other parts of the timescape.

##### Scalar Assault {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-8/scalar-assault"}


*You warp reality to grow a limb for just a moment and make a single devastating attack.*

| **Area, Psionic**      |               **Main action** |
|------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 3 [cube](../../Browse/rule/combat/cube.md) within 1** | **🎯 Each enemy in the area** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md):**

- **≤11:** 12 psychic damage; [push](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 3
- **12-16:** 17 psychic damage; [push](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 5
- **17+:** 23 psychic damage; [push](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 7

##### Synaptic Anchor {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-8/synaptic-anchor"}


*You disrupt an enemy's strike and create a [feedback loop](../../Browse/feature/ability/talent/level-1/feedback-loop.md) in their mind, preventing them from focusing on future attacks.*

| **Psionic**            |           **Free triggered** |
|------------------------|-----------------------------:|
| **📏 Self; see below** |  **🎯 Self or one creature** |

**Trigger:** The target takes damage from another creature's ability while in the area of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability.

**Effect:** The target takes half the damage, and if the triggering creature has I < AVERAGE, they are [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends). While the triggering creature is [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) this way, they take psychic damage equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score whenever they use a main action.

### 9th-Level Features

As a 9th-level [null](../../Browse/class/null.md), you gain the following features.

#### I Am the Weapon {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-9/i-am-the-weapon"}

Your [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) increases by 21 and you can't be made [bleeding](../../Browse/condition/bleeding.md) even while [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md). You no longer age or have need of food. Additionally, you can use [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) instead of another [characteristic](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md) when resisting [potencies](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md).

#### 9th-Level Tradition Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-9/9th-level-tradition-ability"}

Your [null tradition](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-tradition.md) grants your choice of one of two [heroic abilities](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md).

##### 9th-Level Chronokinetic Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Arrestor Cycle {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-9/arrestor-cycle"}


*You trap your foe in a looping cycle of time, where they relive the last few seconds over and over again.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |  **Free triggered** |
|---------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**    | **🎯 One creature** |

**Trigger:** The triggering creature starts their [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md):**

- **≤11:** I < WEAK, the target loses their [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md)
- **12-16:** I < AVERAGE, the target loses their [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md)
- **17+:** I < STRONG, the target loses their [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md)

**Effect:** If the target loses their [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), the round continues as if they had acted. A target who doesn't lose their [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) takes psychic damage equal to twice your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score for each main action they take until the end of their next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

###### Time Loop {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-9/time-loop"}


*You show shadows what true [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) is.*

| **Psionic** | **Free triggered** |
|-------------|-------------------:|
| **📏 Self** |        **🎯 Self** |

**Trigger:** Another creature on the encounter map ends their [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

**Effect:** You take a [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) immediately after the triggering creature. This ability can be used only once per [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md).

##### 9th-Level Cryokinetic Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Absolute Zero {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-9/absolute-zero"}


*You become the coldest thing in the timescape.*

| **Psionic** | **Maneuver** |
|-------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self** |  **🎯 Self** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md):**

- **≤11:** You gain 20 [temporary Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina.md).
- **12-16:** You gain 30 [temporary Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina.md).
- **17+:** You gain 40 [temporary Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina.md).

**Effect:** Until the end of the encounter or until you are dead, you become an avatar of uttermost cold. You gain immunity to all damage equal to the cold [damage immunity](../../Browse/rule/damage/damage-immunity.md) granted by your [Entropic Adaptability](../../Browse/feature/null/level-2/entropic-adaptability.md) trait, you ignore the negative effects of [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md), and you have a +2 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [potencies](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md).

###### Heat Drain {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-9/heat-drain"}


*You drain all the heat from the target.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), Psionic, [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md)** |        **Maneuver** |
|----------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1**             | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md):**

- **≤11:** 8 + I cold damage; M < WEAK, [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) (save ends)
- **12-16:** 11 + I cold damage; M < AVERAGE, [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) (save ends)
- **17+:** 15 + I cold damage; M < STRONG, [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) (save ends)

**Effect:** While [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) this way, the target takes cold damage equal to your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score at the start of each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md). Additionally, whenever the target damages another creature while [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) this way, any [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) associated with the damage is reduced by 2.

##### 9th-Level Metakinetic Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Inertial Absorption {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-9/inertial-absorption"}


*You absorb an attack to empower your body.*

| **Psionic** |                  **Free triggered** |
| -----------------------------|------------------------------------:|
| **📏 Self** |  **🎯 Self** |

**Trigger:** Another creature damages you using an ability.

**Effect:** You take half the damage, negate any effects associated with the damage for you, and gain 3 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md).

###### Realitas {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.null.level-9/realitas"}


*Your essential hyperreality disrupts your enemy's connection to existence.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), Psionic, [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |     **Main action** |
|------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1**                     | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md):**

- **≤11:** 7 + A psychic damage; I < WEAK, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md)
- **12-16:** 10 + A psychic damage; I < AVERAGE, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md)
- **17+:** 13 + A psychic damage; I < STRONG, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md)

**Effect:** While [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) this way, the target takes psychic damage equal to twice your [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) score at the start of each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md). If this ability causes a creature who is not a leader or solo creature to become [winded](../../Browse/rule/health/winded.md), they are instead reduced to 0 [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md). Any creature reduced to 0 [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) by this ability is forgotten by all creatures of your level or lower in the timescape who are not present in the encounter. Loved ones of the forgotten creature retain a faint sense of melancholy. This effect can be reversed only at the Director's discretion.

### 10th-Level Features

As a 10th-level [null](../../Browse/class/null.md), you gain the following features.

#### Characteristic Increase {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-10/characteristic-increase"}

Your [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md) and [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) scores each increase to 5.

#### Discipline Mastery Improvement {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-10/discipline-mastery-improvement"}

Your [Discipline Mastery](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/discipline-mastery.md) feature provides additional benefits when you have 12 or more discipline.

#### Manifold Body {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-10/manifold-body"}

When you gain discipline at the start of each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) during combat, you gain 4 discipline instead of 3.

#### Manifold Resonance {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-10/manifold-resonance"}

Your body becomes perfected matter, beyond the whims and chaos of the timescape and the restrictions of the manifolds. Each time you finish a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md), you can [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) yourself and any creatures in the area of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability to any location in the timescape known to you, known to any other creature in the area, or where any [supernatural](../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural.md) treasure in the area has been before.

Whenever you use an ability, you gain 1 discipline that can be used only to apply a benefit from your [Psi Boost](../../Browse/feature/null/level-7/psi-boost.md) feature to that ability. Additionally, you and allies in the area of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) ability ignore [banes](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) and double [banes](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on your [power rolls](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md).

#### Order {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-10/order"}

You have an epic resource called order. Each time you finish a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md), you gain order equal to the [XP](../../Browse/rule/resource/experience.md) you gain. You can spend order on your abilities as if it were discipline.

At the start of a combat encounter, you can spend 1 order to increase the size of your [Null Field](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/null-field.md) by 1 until the end of the encounter.

Order remains until you spend it.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-10/perk"}

You gain one exploration, interpersonal, or intrigue perk of your choice.

#### Skill {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-10/skill"}

You gain one skill of your choice.

## Shadow {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/class/shadow"}

Subtlety is your art, the tip of the blade your brush. You studied at a secret college, specializing in alchemy, illusion, or [shadow](../../Browse/class/shadow.md)-magics. Your training and knowledge place you among the elite ranks of assassins, spies, and commandos. But more potent than any weapon or sorcery is your insight into your enemies' weaknesses.

**As a [shadow](../../Browse/class/shadow.md), you possess abilities that deal significant damage, enable you to move swiftly across the battlefield and evade hazards, and allow you to fade from notice even in the midst of the most intense combat encounters. You also possess more skills than any other hero.**

"Whenever there is doubt, there is no doubt." **Motto of the College of Black Ash**

### Basics

**Starting [Characteristics](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md):** You start with an [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md) of 2, and you can choose one of the following arrays for your other [characteristic](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md) scores:

- 2, 2, −1, −1
- 2, 1, 1, −1
- 2, 1, 0, 0
- 1, 1, 1, 0

**Weak [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md) − 2

**Average [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md) − 1

**Strong [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md)

**Starting [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) at 1st Level:** 18

**[Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) Gained at 2nd and Higher Levels:** 6

**[Recoveries](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md):** 8

**Skills:** You gain the Hide and Sneak skills (see Skills in Chapter 9: [Tests](tests.md)). Then choose any five skills from Criminal Underworld or the skills of the [exploration](../../Browse/skill/exploration/exploration.md), [interpersonal](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/interpersonal.md), or [intrigue](../../Browse/skill/intrigue/intrigue.md) skill groups. (*Quick Build:*  Criminal Underworld, Hide, Lie, Pick Lock, Pick Pocket, Sabotage, Sneak.)
