| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10** | **🎯 Three allies** |

**Effect:** Each target can make a [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md).

##### This Is What We Planned For {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-1/this-is-what-we-planned-for"}


*All those coordination drills you made them do finally pay off.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**       |      **Maneuver** |
|------------------|------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10** | **🎯 Two allies** |

**Effect:** Each target who hasn't acted yet this [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) can take their [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) in any order immediately after yours.

### 2nd-Level Features

As a 2nd-level [tactician](../../Browse/class/tactician.md), you gain the following features.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-2/perk"}

You gain one exploration, interpersonal, or intrigue perk of your choice. See Chapter 7: [Perks](perks.md).

#### 2nd-Level Doctrine Feature {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-2/2nd-level-doctrine-feature"}

Your [tactical doctrine](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-1/tactical-doctrine.md) grants you a feature, as shown on the 2nd-Level Doctrine Features table.

###### 2nd-Level Doctrine Features Table

| Doctrine                    | Feature              |
|-----------------------------|----------------------|
| Insurgent                   | [Infiltration Tactics](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-2/infiltration-tactics.md) |
| Mastermind                  | Goaded               |
| Vanguard                    | [Melee Superiority](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-2/melee-superiority.md)    |

##### Goaded {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-2/goaded"}

You have learned to leverage your marked foes' psychology and goad them into acting before they're tactically ready. Whenever a creature marked by you uses a [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) that targets you or any ally within your [line of effect](../../Browse/rule/combat/line-of-effect.md), you can use a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) to change one target of the [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) to you or another ally within your [line of effect](../../Browse/rule/combat/line-of-effect.md). The new target must be within [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) of the ability and within [line of effect](../../Browse/rule/combat/line-of-effect.md) of the creature using it.

##### Infiltration Tactics {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-2/infiltration-tactics"}

You have trained your squad to work together, stay silent, and wait for the opportune time to strike. Whenever you or any ally within 10 squares of you becomes hidden, that creature gains 1 [surge](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md).

##### Melee Superiority {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-2/melee-superiority"}

After constant drills, you can more accurately anticipate an enemy's plan and thwart their attempts to move across the battlefield. Whenever you make an [opportunity attack](../../Browse/rule/combat/opportunity-attack.md), the target's [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) is reduced to 0 until the end of the current [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

**Mark Benefit:** When a creature marked by you attempts to move or [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) within [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) of your [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md), you can use a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) and spend 2 focus to make a [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) against that creature.

#### 2nd-Level Doctrine Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-2/2nd-level-doctrine-ability"}

Your [tactical doctrine](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-1/tactical-doctrine.md) grants your choice of one of two [heroic abilities](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md).

##### 2nd-Level Insurgent Ability

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Fog of War {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-2/fog-of-war"}


*Your unorthodox strategy causes enemies to lash out in fear, heedless of who they might be attacking.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**       |         **Maneuver** |
|------------------|---------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10** | **🎯 Two creatures** |

**Effect:** Each target is marked by you, and must immediately make a [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) against a creature of your choice within 5 squares of them.

**Mark Benefit:** Until the end of the encounter, whenever you or any ally makes a [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) against a creature marked by you, you can spend 2 focus to force that target to make a [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) against a creature of your choice within 5 squares of them.

###### Try Me Instead {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-2/try-me-instead"}


*"Try picking on someone my [size](../../Browse/rule/character/size.md)."*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** | **Main action** |
|---------------------------|----------------:|
| **📏 Self; see below**    |     **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** You [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) up to your [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) directly toward an ally, ending [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) to them, then swapping locations with that ally as long as you can fit into each other's spaces. The ally can spend a [Recovery](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md), and you can make the following weapon [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) with a [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) of [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1 against a creature.

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** 2 + R damage; R < WEAK, [frightened](../../Browse/condition/frightened.md) (save ends)
- **12-16:** 3 + R damage; R < AVERAGE, [frightened](../../Browse/condition/frightened.md) (save ends)
- **17+:** 4 + R damage; R < STRONG, [frightened](../../Browse/condition/frightened.md) (save ends)

##### 2nd-Level Mastermind Ability

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### I've Got Your Back {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-2/ive-got-your-back"}


*Your enemy will think twice about attacking your friend.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |     **Main action** |
|----------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 5**            | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** 5 + R damage; [taunted](../../Browse/condition/taunted.md) ([EoT](../../Browse/rule/combat/end-of-turn.md))
- **12-16:** 9 + R damage; [taunted](../../Browse/condition/taunted.md) ([EoT](../../Browse/rule/combat/end-of-turn.md))
- **17+:** 12 + R damage; [taunted](../../Browse/condition/taunted.md) ([EoT](../../Browse/rule/combat/end-of-turn.md))

**Effect:** One ally [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) to the target can spend a [Recovery](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md).

###### Targets of Opportunity {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-2/targets-of-opportunity"}


*You point out easy targets to your friends, allowing them to include more enemies in their attacks.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**      |         **Maneuver** |
|-----------------|---------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 5** | **🎯 Two creatures** |

**Effect:** Each target is marked by you, and you gain two [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md).

**Mark Benefit:** Until the end of the encounter, whenever you or any ally makes a [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) against a creature marked by you, you can spend 2 focus to add one additional target to the [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md).

##### 2nd-Level Vanguard Ability

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### No Dying on My Watch {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-2/no-dying-on-my-watch"}


*You prioritize saving an ally over your own safety.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |    **Triggered** |
|----------------------------|-----------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 5**            | **🎯 One enemy** |

**Trigger:** The target deals damage to an ally.

**Effect:** You move up to your [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) toward the triggering ally, ending this movement [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) to them or in the nearest square if you can't reach an [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) square. The triggering ally can spend a [Recovery](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md) and gains 5 [temporary Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina.md) for each enemy you came [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) to during the move. You then make a [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) against the target.

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md):**

- **≤11:** R < WEAK, the target is [frightened](../../Browse/condition/frightened.md) of the triggering ally (save ends)
- **12-16:** R < AVERAGE, the target is [frightened](../../Browse/condition/frightened.md) of the triggering ally (save ends)
- **17+:** R < STRONG, the target is [frightened](../../Browse/condition/frightened.md) of the triggering ally (save ends)

###### Squad! On Me! {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-2/squad-on-me"}


*Together we are invincible!*

| **Area**       |                          **Maneuver** |
|----------------|--------------------------------------:|
| **📏 1 [burst](../../Browse/rule/combat/burst.md)** | **🎯 Self and each ally in the area** |

**Effect:** Until the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), each target has a [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [stability](../../Browse/rule/character/stability.md) equal to your [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md) score. Additionally, each target gains 2 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md).

### 3rd-Level Features

As a 3rd-level [tactician](../../Browse/class/tactician.md), you gain the following features.

#### Out of Position {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-3/out-of-position"}

Even before battle begins, your enemies struggle to keep up with your tactics. At the start of an encounter, you can use a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) to use your Mark ability against one enemy you have [line of effect](../../Browse/rule/combat/line-of-effect.md) to, even if you are [surprised](../../Browse/rule/combat/surprised.md). You can then [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) the marked target up to 3 squares, ignoring [stability](../../Browse/rule/character/stability.md). The target can't be moved in a way that would harm them (such as over a cliff), leave them [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md), or result in them suffering a [condition](../../Browse/rule/combat/condition.md) or other negative effect.

#### 7-Focus Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-3/7-focus-ability"}

Choose one [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) from the following options, each of which costs 7 focus to use.

##### Frontal Assault {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-3/frontal-assault"}


*The purpose of a charge is to break their morale and force a retreat.*

| **-**       | **Maneuver** |
|-------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self** |  **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** Until the end of the encounter or until you are [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md), the first time on a [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) that you or any ally deals damage to a target marked by you, the creature who dealt the damage can [push](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) the target up to 2 squares and then [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) up to 2 squares. Additionally, any ally using the [Charge](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/charge.md) main action to target a creature marked by you can use a [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) [signature ability](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) or a [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) instead of a [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md).

##### Hit 'Em Hard! {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-3/hit-em-hard"}


*Your allies see the advantages in attacking the targets you select.*

| **-**       | **Maneuver** |
|-------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self** |  **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** Until the end of the encounter or until you are [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md), whenever you or any ally deals damage to a target marked by you, that creature gains 2 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md), which they can use immediately.

##### Rout {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-3/rout"}


*The tide begins to [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).*

| **-**       | **Maneuver** |
|-------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self** |  **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** Until the end of the encounter or until you are [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md), whenever you or any ally deals damage to a target marked by you who has R < AVERAGE, the target is [frightened](../../Browse/condition/frightened.md) of the creature who dealt the damage (save ends).

##### Stay Strong and Focus! {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-3/stay-strong-and-focus"}


*"We can do this! Keep faith and hold fast!"*

| **-**       | **Maneuver** |
|-------------|-------------:|
| **📏 Self** |  **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** Until the end of the encounter or until you are [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md), whenever you or any ally deals damage to a target marked by you, the creature who dealt the damage can spend a [Recovery](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md).

### 4th-Level Features

As a 4th-level [tactician](../../Browse/class/tactician.md), you gain the following features.

#### Characteristic Increase {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-4/characteristic-increase"}

Your [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md) and [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) scores each increase to 3.

#### Focus on Their Weaknesses {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-4/focus-on-their-weaknesses"}

The first time each [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) that you or any ally damages a target marked by you, you gain 2 focus instead of 1.

#### Improved Field Arsenal {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-4/improved-field-arsenal"}

Your expertise with weapons has grown. Whenever you use a [signature ability](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) from one of your equipped kits or make a [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) using a weapon from one of your equipped kits, you gain an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md).

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-4/perk"}

You gain one perk of your choice.

#### Skill {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-4/skill"}

You gain one skill of your choice. See Skills in Chapter 9: [Tests](tests.md).

### 5th-Level Features

As a 5th-level [tactician](../../Browse/class/tactician.md), you gain the following features.

#### 5th-Level Doctrine Features {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-5/5th-level-doctrine-features"}

Your [tactical doctrine](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-1/tactical-doctrine.md) grants you two features, as shown on the 5th-Level Doctrine Features table.

###### 5th-Level Doctrine Features Table

| Doctrine   | Features                         |
|------------|----------------------------------|
| Insurgent  | [Distracted](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-5/distracted.md), [Leave No Trace](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-5/leave-no-trace.md)       |
| Mastermind | [Anticipation](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-5/anticipation.md), [I Predicted That](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-5/i-predicted-that.md)   |
| Vanguard   | [Shake It Off](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-5/shake-it-off.md), [Tactical Offensive](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-5/tactical-offensive.md) |

##### Anticipation {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-5/anticipation"}

You have learned to be more preemptive on the battlefield, thinking more steps ahead than your opponents. You can target two creatures with your Mark ability.

##### Distracted {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-5/distracted"}

You have mastered the ability to distract your foes, allowing you and your allies to take advantage of their gaps in attention. Whenever you or any ally attempts to hide, any creature marked by you doesn't count as an observer. Additionally, you and your allies can use other allies as [cover](../../Browse/rule/combat/cover.md) for the purpose of hiding.

##### I Predicted That {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-5/i-predicted-that"}

Your expertise in history and lore allows you and your allies to outthink rivals in the present day. You and any ally within 10 squares of you gain an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) [tests](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md).

##### Leave No Trace {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-5/leave-no-trace"}

You and any ally within 10 squares of you can move at full [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) while sneaking. Additionally, enemies within 10 squares of you take a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on [tests](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md) made to search for you or your allies while any of you are hidden.

##### Shake It Off {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-5/shake-it-off"}

As a [free maneuver](../../Browse/rule/combat/free-maneuver.md), you can spend 1d6 [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) to ignore a consequence from a [test](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md), or to end one effect on you that is ended by a [saving throw](../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw.md) or that ends at the end of your [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md). Any ally [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) to you can also spend [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) as a [free maneuver](../../Browse/rule/combat/free-maneuver.md) to gain this benefit.

##### Tactical Offensive {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-5/tactical-offensive"}

When you use the [Charge](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/charge.md) main action to attack a creature marked by you, you can use a signature or [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) with the [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) and Strike keywords instead of a [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md).

#### 9-Focus Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-5/9-focus-ability"}

Choose one [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) from the following options, each of which costs 9 focus to use.

##### Squad! Gear Check! {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-5/squad-gear-check"}


*You distract a foe while your allies secure their defensive gear.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** | **Main action**     |
|---------------------------|---------------------|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1**            | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md):**

- **≤11:** 9 + M damage
- **12-16:** 13 + M damage
- **17+:** 18 + M damage

**Effect:** You and each ally [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) to the target gain 10 [temporary Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina.md).

##### Squad! Remember Your Training! {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-5/squad-remember-your-training"}


*You remind your allies how to best use their gear.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**                |                         **Main action** |
|------------------------------|----------------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**  | **🎯 Self and two allies** |

**Effect:** Each target gains 1 [surge](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md) and can use a [signature ability](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) that has a double [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md).

##### Win This Day! {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-5/win-this-day"}


*You inspire your allies to recover and gather their strength.*

| **Area**       |                       **Main action** |
|----------------|--------------------------------------:|
| **📏 3 [burst](../../Browse/rule/combat/burst.md)** | **🎯 Self and each ally in the area** |

**Effect:** Each target gains 2 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md). Additionally, they can spend a [Recovery](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md), remove any [conditions](../../Browse/rule/combat/condition.md) or effects on them, and stand up if they [are prone](../../Browse/condition/prone.md).

##### You've Still Got Something Left {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-5/youve-still-got-something-left"}


*You push an ally to use a [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) sooner than they otherwise would.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**       | **Main action** |
|------------------|----------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10** | **🎯 One ally** |

**Effect:** The target uses a [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) with the [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) keyword as a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md), and deals extra damage with that ability equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score. The ability has its [Heroic Resource](../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource.md) cost reduced by 1 + your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score (minimum cost 0).

### 6th-Level Features

As a 6th-level [tactician](../../Browse/class/tactician.md), you gain the following features.

#### Master of Arms {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-6/master-of-arms"}

Your expertise with weapons has grown to true mastery. Whenever you use a [signature ability](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) from one of your equipped kits or make a [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) using a weapon from one of your equipped kits, you can negate a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) or reduce a double [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) to a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md).

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-6/perk"}

You gain one exploration, interpersonal, or intrigue perk of your choice.

#### 6th-Level Doctrine Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-6/6th-level-doctrine-ability"}

Your [tactical doctrine](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-1/tactical-doctrine.md) grants your choice of one of two [heroic abilities](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md).

##### 6th-Level Insurgent Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Coordinated Execution {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-6/coordinated-execution"}


*You direct your ally to make a killing blow.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**       | **Free triggered** |
|------------------|-------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10** |    **🎯 One ally** |

**Trigger:** The target uses an ability to deal [rolled damage](../../Browse/rule/damage/rolled-damage.md) to a creature while hidden.

**Effect:** If the target of the triggering ability is not a leader or solo creature, they are reduced to 0 [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md). If the target of the triggering ability is a minion, the entire squad is killed. If the target of the triggering ability is a leader or solo creature, the triggering ability's [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) automatically obtains a tier 3 outcome.

###### Panic in Their Lines {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-6/panic-in-their-lines"}


*You confuse your foes, causing them to turn on each other.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |      **Main action** |
|-----------------------------------|---------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1 or [ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 5**        | **🎯 Two creatures** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md):**

- **≤11:** 6 + M damage; [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 1
- **12-16:** 9 + M damage; [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 3
- **17+:** 13 + M damage; [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 5

**Effect:** If a target is [force moved](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) into another creature, they must make a [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) against that creature.

##### 6th-Level Mastermind Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Battle Plan {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-6/battle-plan"}


*With new understanding of your foes, you create the perfect plan to win the battle.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**       |           **Maneuver** |
|------------------|-----------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10** | **🎯 Three creatures** |

**Effect:** Each target is marked by you. Immediately and until the end of the encounter, the Director tells you if any creatures marked by you have [damage immunity](../../Browse/rule/damage/damage-immunity.md) or weakness and the value of that immunity or weakness. Additionally, you and each ally within 3 squares of you gains 2 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md).

**Mark Benefit:** Until the end of the encounter, whenever you or any ally makes a [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) against a creature marked by you, you can spend 2 focus to make the [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) ignore [damage immunity](../../Browse/rule/damage/damage-immunity.md) and deal extra damage equal to three times your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score.

###### Hustle! {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-6/hustle"}


*You and your allies coordinate to form a new battle line.*

| **Area**       |                          **Maneuver** |
|----------------|--------------------------------------:|
| **📏 2 [burst](../../Browse/rule/combat/burst.md)** | **🎯 Self and each ally in the area** |

**Effect:** You mark two enemies within 10 squares of you. Each target can [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) up to their [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md). You and each target gain 2 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md).

##### 6th-Level Vanguard Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Instant Retaliation {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-6/instant-retaliation"}


*You [parry](../../Browse/feature/ability/tactician/level-1/parry.md) with almost [supernatural](../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural.md) [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md).*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), Weapon** | **Free triggered** |
| ------------------------------------|-------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1**                   |    **🎯 One ally** |

**Trigger:** A creature deals damage to the target.

**Effect:** The target takes half the damage. You then make a [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) against the triggering creature.

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md):**

- **≤11:** A < WEAK, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends)
- **12-16:** A < AVERAGE, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends)
- **17+:** A < STRONG, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends)

###### To Me Squad! {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-6/to-me-squad"}


*You lead your allies in a charge.*

| **Charge, [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |     **Main action** |
|-----------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1**                    | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md):**

- **≤11:** 6 + M damage; one ally within 10 squares can use the [Charge](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/charge.md) main action as a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md), and can use a [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) [signature ability](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) instead of a [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) for the charge
- **12-16:** 9 + M damage; one ally within 10 squares can use the [Charge](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/charge.md) main action as a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md), and can use a [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) [signature ability](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) that gains an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) instead of a [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) for the charge
- **17+:** 13 + M damage; two allies within 10 squares can use the [Charge](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/charge.md) main action as a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md), and can each use a [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) [signature ability](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) that gains an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) instead of a [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) for the charge

**Effect:** If the target is hit with two or more strikes as part of this ability and they have R < STRONG, they are [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends). If the target is reduced to 0 [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) before one or both allies has made their [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), the ally or allies can pick a different target.

### 7th-Level Features

As a 7th-level [tactician](../../Browse/class/tactician.md), you gain the following features.

#### Characteristic Increase {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-7/characteristic-increase"}

Each of your [characteristic](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md) scores increases by 1, to a maximum of 4.

#### Heightened Focus {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-7/heightened-focus"}

When you gain focus at the start of each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) during combat, you gain 3 focus instead of 2.

#### Seize the Initiative {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-7/seize-the-initiative"}

If you are not [surprised](../../Browse/rule/combat/surprised.md) when combat begins, your side gets to go first. If an enemy has an ability that allows their side to go first, you roll as usual to determine who goes first.

#### Skill {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-7/skill"}

You gain one skill of your choice.

#### 7th-Level Doctrine Feature {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-7/7th-level-doctrine-feature"}

Your [tactical doctrine](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-1/tactical-doctrine.md) grants you a feature, as shown on the 7th-Level Doctrine Features table.

###### 7th-Level Doctrine Features Table

| Doctrine   | Feature            |
|------------|--------------------|
| Insurgent  | [Asymmetric Warfare](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-7/asymmetric-warfare.md) |
| Mastermind | [Grand Strategy](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-7/grand-strategy.md)     |
| Vanguard   | [Shock and Awe](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-7/shock-and-awe.md)      |

##### Asymmetric Warfare {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-7/asymmetric-warfare"}

You have advanced your skills in subterfuge, now directing full battlefield strategy and logistics. During a [montage test](../../Browse/rule/test/montage-test.md) or negotiation, you can obtain one automatic success on a [test](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md) made using a skill from the [intrigue skill group](../../Browse/skill/intrigue/intrigue.md). Additionally, you can use skills from the [intrigue skill group](../../Browse/skill/intrigue/intrigue.md) to conceal large groups of people, such as escaping civilians and groups of guerilla warriors.

##### Grand Strategy {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-7/grand-strategy"}

You have grown your skills in strategy, wielding intricate battlefield tactics and plans. During a [montage test](../../Browse/rule/test/montage-test.md) or negotiation, you can obtain one automatic success on a [test](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md) made using a skill from the [lore skill group](../../Browse/skill/lore/lore.md). Additionally, when you take a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md), you can make a [project roll](../../Browse/rule/downtime/project-roll.md) for a [research project](../../Browse/rule/downtime/research-project.md) in addition to undertaking another [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md) activity.

##### Shock and Awe {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-7/shock-and-awe"}

You have expanded your leadership skills, strengthening your [followers](../../Browse/rule/general/follower.md)' morale and providing logistical support. During a [montage test](../../Browse/rule/test/montage-test.md) or negotiation, you can obtain one automatic success on a [test](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md) made using a skill from the [interpersonal skill group](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/interpersonal.md). Additionally, you can convince a group of people to help you with a [crafting project](../../Browse/rule/downtime/crafting-project.md) during a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md). If these people are available when you take a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md), you can make a [project roll](../../Browse/rule/downtime/project-roll.md) for a [crafting project](../../Browse/rule/downtime/crafting-project.md) in addition to undertaking another [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md) activity.

### 8th-Level Features

As an 8th-level [tactician](../../Browse/class/tactician.md), you gain the following features.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-8/perk"}

You gain one perk of your choice.

#### 8th-Level Doctrine Feature {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-8/8th-level-doctrine-feature"}

Your [tactical doctrine](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-1/tactical-doctrine.md) grants you a feature, as shown on the 8th-Level Doctrine Features table.

###### 8th-Level Doctrine Features Table

| Doctrine   | Feature                            |
|------------|------------------------------------|
| Insurgent  | [Bait and Ambush](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-8/bait-and-ambush.md)                    |
| Mastermind | [Pincer Movement](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-8/pincer-movement.md)                    |
| Vanguard   | [See Your Enemies Driven Before You](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-8/see-your-enemies-driven-before-you.md) |

##### Bait and Ambush {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-8/bait-and-ambush"}

You have trained your squad to be silent ambushers.

**Mark Benefit:** When you or any ally makes a [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) against a creature marked by you, you can spend 2 focus to let the character making the [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) up to a number of squares equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score and use the [Hide](../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/hide.md) maneuver as a [free maneuver](../../Browse/rule/combat/free-maneuver.md) once during the [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md). The creature can [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) before or after the [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) is resolved.

##### Pincer Movement {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-8/pincer-movement"}

You have trained your squad to coordinate their movements to maximize combat impact.

**Mark Benefit:** When you or any ally makes a [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) against a creature marked by you, you can spend 2 focus to have the character making the [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) up to a number of squares equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score before the [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) is resolved. If you didn't make the [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), you can make this [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) as well. If you did make the [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), one ally within 10 squares of you can make this [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) as well.

##### See Your Enemies Driven Before You {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-8/see-your-enemies-driven-before-you"}

You have trained your squad to maximize impact and break enemy lines when they attack.

**Mark Benefit:** When you or any ally makes a [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) against a creature marked by you, you can spend 2 focus to have the character making the [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) [push](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) the target up to a number of squares equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score. That character can then [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) up to a number of squares equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score, ending this [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) to the target.

#### 11-Focus Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-8/11-focus-ability"}

Choose one [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) from the following options, each of which costs 11 focus to use.

##### Go Now and Speed Well {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-8/go-now-and-speed-well"}


*You direct an attack to strike true.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**       |         **Main action** |
|------------------|------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10** | **🎯 Self or one ally** |

**Effect:** The target gains 2 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md) and can use a signature or [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) as a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md). The ability has a double [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md), ignores [damage immunity](../../Browse/rule/damage/damage-immunity.md), and increases the [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) of any [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) effects by 1.

##### Finish Them! {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-8/finish-them"}


*You point out an opening to your ally so they can land a killing blow.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**       |  **Free triggered** |
|------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10** | **🎯 One creature** |

**Trigger:** The target is not a leader or solo creature, and becomes [winded](../../Browse/rule/health/winded.md).

**Effect:** The target is killed. Additionally, the creature who caused the target to be [winded](../../Browse/rule/health/winded.md) can spend a [Recovery](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md).

##### Floodgates Open {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-8/floodgates-open"}


*You direct your squad to strike in unison and with devastating effect.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**       |     **Main action** |
|------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10** | **🎯 Three allies** |

**Effect:** Each target gains 1 [surge](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md) and can use a [signature ability](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) as a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md). That ability gains an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) and increases the [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) of any [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) effects by 1.

##### I'll Open and You'll Close {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-8/ill-open-and-youll-close"}


*You create an opening for an ally.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |     **Main action** |
|-----------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1 or [ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 5**        | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md):**

- **≤11:** 6 + M damage
- **12-16:** 10 + M damage
- **17+:** 14 + M damage

**Effect:** One ally within 10 squares of you can use a [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) against the target as a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) without spending any of their [Heroic Resource](../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource.md), as long as they have enough [Heroic Resource](../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource.md) to pay for the ability. If the target is reduced to 0 [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) before the chosen ally has used their ability, the ally can pick a different target.

### 9th-Level Features

As a 9th-level [tactician](../../Browse/class/tactician.md), you gain the following features.

#### Grandmaster of Arms {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-9/grandmaster-of-arms"}

Your expertise with weapons has grown to true mastery. Whenever you use a [signature ability](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) from one of your equipped kits or make a [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) using a weapon from one of your equipped kits, you automatically obtain a tier 3 outcome on the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md). You can still roll to determine if you score a [critical hit](../../Browse/rule/combat/critical-hit.md).

#### 9th-Level Doctrine Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-9/9th-level-doctrine-ability"}

Your [tactical doctrine](../../Browse/feature/tactician/level-1/tactical-doctrine.md) grants your choice of one of two [heroic abilities](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md).

##### 9th-Level Insurgent Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Squad! Hit and Run! {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-9/squad-hit-and-run"}


*I had to pry this secret from the [shadow college](../../Browse/feature/shadow/level-1/shadow-college.md)s.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**       |            **Main action** |
|------------------|---------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10** | **🎯 Self and two allies** |

**Effect:** Each target gains 2 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md), and can use a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) to use a [signature ability](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) that gains an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md). After resolving their ability, each target can [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) up to 2 squares and become hidden even if they have no [cover](../../Browse/rule/combat/cover.md) or [concealment](../../Browse/rule/combat/concealment.md), or if they are observed.

###### Their Lack of Focus Is Their Undoing {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-9/their-lack-of-focus-is-their-undoing"}

| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**          | **🎯 Three enemies** |

**Effect:** Each target uses a [signature ability](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) against one or more targets of your choosing, with each ability automatically obtaining a tier 3 outcome on the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md). After resolving the targets' abilities, you make a [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) against each original target.

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md):**

- **≤11:** R < WEAK, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends)
- **12-16:** R < AVERAGE, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends)
- **17+:** R < STRONG, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends)

##### 9th-Level Mastermind Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

A target ignores [banes](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) and double [banes](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) when making this [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md).

###### Counterstrategy {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-9/counterstrategy"}


*I've identified a way to negate their strengths.*

| **-**       | **Main action** |

**Effect:** You gain 6 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md). Until the end of the encounter or until you are [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md), whenever the Director spends Malice (see *Draw Steel: Monsters*), choose yourself or one ally within 10 squares. The chosen character gains 2 of their [Heroic Resource](../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource.md).

##### 9th-Level Vanguard Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### No Escape {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-9/no-escape"}


*Nothing will stop you from reaching your foe.*

| **Charge, [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |     **Main action** |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------: |
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1**                    | **🎯 One creature** |

**Effect:** You mark the target.

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md):**

- **≤11:** 11 + M damage
- **12-16:** 16 + M damage
- **17+:** 21 + M damage

**Effect:** If you use this ability as part of the [Charge](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/charge.md) main action, enemies' spaces don't count as [difficult terrain](../../Browse/movement/difficult-terrain.md) for your movement. Additionally, if you move through any creature's space, you can [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) that creature 1 square out of the path of your charge.

###### That One Is Mine! {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-9/that-one-is-mine"}


*You focus on making an enemy irrelevant.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Weapon** |     **Main action** |
|-----------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1 or [ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 5**        | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md):**

**Effect:** Until the end of the encounter or until you are [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md), you can use a signature or [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) instead of a [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) against any target marked by you.

### 10th-Level Features

As a 10th-level [tactician](../../Browse/class/tactician.md), you gain the following features.

#### Characteristic Increase {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-10/characteristic-increase"}

Your [Might](../../Browse/rule/character/might.md) and [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) scores each increase to 5.

#### Command {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-10/command"}

You have an epic resource called command. Each time you finish a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md), you gain command equal to the [XP](../../Browse/rule/resource/experience.md) you gain. You can spend command on your abilities as if it were focus.

Additionally, whenever you or any ally uses an ability to deal [rolled damage](../../Browse/rule/damage/rolled-damage.md) to a creature marked by you, you can spend 1 command as a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) to increase the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) outcome for that target by one tier. Whenever an enemy marked by you makes an [ability roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/ability-roll.md), you can spend 1 command as a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) to decrease the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) outcome by one tier.

Command remains until you spend it.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-10/perk"}

You gain one exploration, interpersonal, or intrigue perk of your choice.

#### Skill {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-10/skill"}

You gain one skill of your choice.

#### True Focus {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-10/true-focus"}

When you gain focus at the start of each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) during combat, you gain 4 focus instead of 3.

#### Warmaster {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-10/warmaster"}

You have mastered the entirety of possible strategies and tactics. Whenever you or any ally makes an [ability roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/ability-roll.md) against a target marked by you, the character making the roll can roll three dice and choose which two to use.

Additionally, whenever an ally uses a [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) that targets one or more creatures marked by you, they spend 2 fewer of their [Heroic Resource](../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource.md) on that ability (minimum 1).

## Talent {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/class/talent"}

Arare few people are born with the potential to harness psionic power, but only those who experience an awakening, a significant event that activates a [talent's](../../Browse/class/talent.md) abilities, can tap into the mind's full potential. You are one of those people—a master of psionics and a source of incredible power created through sheer force of will. You can move and change matter, time, gravity, the laws of physics, or another creature's mind.

**As a [talent](../../Browse/class/talent.md), you are limited only by the strength of your mind. But the ability to wield multiple powers at once and change reality at will involves a gamble. Every manifestation has a chance of harming you, and [talents](../../Browse/class/talent.md) who use too much power too quickly pay a deadly price.**

> "I've seen what you can do! There is NO LIMIT to your power! All you have to do... is BELIEVE!"
>
> **Khorva**

### Basics

**Starting [Characteristics](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md):** You start with a [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) of 2 and a [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md) of 2, and you can choose one of the following arrays for your other [characteristic](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md) scores:

- 2, −1, −1
- 1, 1, −1
- 1, 0, 0

**Weak [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) − 2

**Average [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) − 1

**Strong [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md)

**Starting [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) at 1st Level:** 18

**[Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) Gained at 2nd and Higher Levels:** 6

**[Recoveries](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md):** 8

**Skills:** You gain the Psionics and [Read Person](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/read-person.md) skills (see Skills in Chapter 9: [Tests](tests.md)). Then choose any two skills from the [interpersonal](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/interpersonal.md) or [lore](../../Browse/skill/lore/lore.md) skill groups. (*Quick Build:* Empathize, Psionics, [Read Person](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/read-person.md), Timescape.)

### 1st-Level Features

As a 1st-level [talent](../../Browse/class/talent.md), you gain the following features.

#### Talent Tradition {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/talent-tradition"}

Psionic abilities are grouped into categories according to their effects, with each category comprising one of many [talent tradition](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/talent-tradition.md)s:

- **Animapathy** abilities allow you to manipulate, meld, and exchange the souls of living things.
- **Chronopathy** abilities allow you to view future and past events, and to manipulate time to aid allies and hinder foes.
- **Cryokinesis** abilities allow you to manifest and manipulate absolute cold to enemies and the environment alike.
- **Metamorphosis** abilities allow you to strengthen and manipulate your body and the bodies of others to perform preternatural exploits.
- **Pyrokinesis** abilities allow you to create and manipulate fire by interacting with the potential energy found in all things.
- **Resopathy** abilities allow you to manipulate matter and space to create, alter, or displace your environment and the creatures and objects in it.
- **Telekinesis** abilities allow you to physically manipulate creatures and objects.
- **Telepathy** abilities allow you to communicate with, read, and influence the minds of other creatures.

You choose a [talent tradition](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/talent-tradition.md) from the following options: chronopathy, telekinesis, or telepathy. Your [talent tradition](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/talent-tradition.md) is your [subclass](../../Browse/rule/general/subclass.md), and your choice of tradition determines many of the features you'll gain as you gain new levels. (Other [talent tradition](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/talent-tradition.md)s will be featured in future products.) (*Quick Build:* Telekinesis.)

#### Clarity and Strain {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/clarity-and-strain"}

The focus and precision of your thoughts grant you a [Heroic Resource](../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource.md) called clarity that empowers your psionic abilities.

##### Clarity in Combat

At the start of a combat encounter or some other stressful situation tracked in [combat rounds](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) (as determined by the Director), you gain clarity equal to your [Victories](../../Browse/rule/resource/victories.md). At the start of each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) during combat, you gain 1d3 clarity.

Additionally, the first time each [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) that a creature is [force moved](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md), you gain 1 clarity.

You can spend clarity you don't have, pushing that [Heroic Resource](../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource.md) into negative numbers to a maximum negative value equal to 1 + your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score. At the end of each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), you take 1 damage for each negative point of clarity.

Whenever you have clarity below 0, you are strained. Some psionic abilities have additional effects if you are already strained or become strained when you use them. Strained effects can still impact you even after you are no longer strained.

You lose any remaining clarity or reset any negative clarity at the end of the encounter.

##### Clarity Outside of Combat

Though you can't gain clarity outside of combat, you can use your [heroic abilities](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) and effects that cost clarity without spending it. Whenever you use an ability or effect outside of combat that costs clarity, you can't use that same ability or effect outside of combat again until you earn 1 or more [Victories](../../Browse/rule/resource/victories.md) or finish a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md).

Additionally, whenever you use any ability or effect that costs clarity within 1 minute of using another such ability, you take 1d6 damage and incur any strain effect from using the new ability. Whenever you use an ability with a strain effect outside of combat, you can take 1d6 damage and incur the effect if you don't incur it for other reasons.

When you use an ability outside of combat that lets you spend unlimited clarity on its effect, such as [Minor Telekinesis](../../Browse/feature/ability/talent/level-1/minor-telekinesis.md), you can use it as if you had spent an amount of clarity equal to your [Victories](../../Browse/rule/resource/victories.md).

#### Mind Spike {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/mind-spike"}

You have the following ability, which can be used as a [ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md).

##### Mind Spike {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-1/mind-spike"}


*A telepathic bolt instantly zaps a creature's brain.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**, **Strike, Telepathy** |     **Main action** |
|--------------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                           | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** 2 + R psychic damage
- **12-16:** 4 + R psychic damage
- **17+:** 6 + R psychic damage

**Strained:** The target takes an extra 2 psychic damage. You also take 2 psychic damage that can't be reduced in any way.

#### Psionic Augmentation {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/psionic-augmentation"}

Through meditation, you create pathways in your mind that enhance your statistics. Choose one of the following augmentations. You can change your augmentation and ward (see [Talent Ward](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/talent-ward.md) below) by undergoing a psionic meditation as a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md) activity. (*Quick Build:*  [Force Augmentation](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/force-augmentation.md).)

##### Battle Augmentation {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/battle-augmentation"}

You can wear light armor and wield light weapons effectively, even though you don't have a kit. While you wear light armor, you gain a +3 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md), and that [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) increases by 3 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels. While you wield a light weapon, you gain a +1 damage [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) with weapon abilities, including [free strikes](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md). You can use light armor treasures and light weapon treasures.

If you have a kit, you can't take this augmentation.

##### Density Augmentation {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/density-augmentation"}

You gain a +6 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md), and this [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) increases by 6 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels. Additionally, you gain a +1 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [stability](../../Browse/rule/character/stability.md).

##### Distance Augmentation {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/distance-augmentation"}

Your [ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) psionic abilities gain a +2 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md).

##### Force Augmentation {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/force-augmentation"}

Your damage-dealing psionic abilities gain a +1 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [rolled damage](../../Browse/rule/damage/rolled-damage.md).

##### Speed Augmentation {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/speed-augmentation"}

You gain a +1 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) and to the [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) you can [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) when you take the [Disengage](../../Browse/feature/common/move-actions/disengage.md) move action.

#### Talent Ward {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/talent-ward"}

Through meditation, you create a ward that protects you. Choose one of the following wards. You can change your ward and [psionic augmentation](../../Browse/feature/null/level-1/psionic-augmentation.md) (see above) by undergoing a psionic meditation as a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md) activity. (*Quick Build:* [Repulsive Ward](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/repulsive-ward.md).)

##### Entropy Ward {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/entropy-ward"}

Your ward slows time for your enemies. Whenever a creature deals damage to you, their [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) is reduced by an amount equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score and they can't use [triggered actions](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) until the end of their next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

##### Repulsive Ward {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/repulsive-ward"}

You surround yourself with an invisible ward of telekinetic energy. Whenever an [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) creature deals damage to you, you can use a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) to [push](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) them up to a number of squares equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score.

##### Steel Ward {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/steel-ward"}

Your ward reacts to danger, protecting you from future harm. Whenever you take damage, after the damage resolves, you gain [damage immunity](../../Browse/rule/damage/damage-immunity.md) equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score until the end of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

##### Vanishing Ward {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/vanishing-ward"}

Your ward allows you to slip away from threats. Whenever you take damage, you become invisible until the end of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

#### Telepathic Speech {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/telepathic-speech"}

You know the Mindspeech language (see Languages in [Orden](../../Browse/rule/world/orden.md) in Chapter 4: [Background](background.md)). Additionally, you can telepathically communicate with any creatures within [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) of your [Mind Spike](../../Browse/feature/ability/talent/level-1/mind-spike.md) ability if they share a language with you and you know of each other. When you communicate with someone this way, they can respond telepathically.

#### 1st-Level Tradition Features {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/1st-level-tradition-features"}

Your [talent tradition](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/talent-tradition.md) grants you two features, as shown on the 1st-Level Tradition Features table.

###### 1st-Level Tradition Features Table

| Telepathy   | [Feedback Loop](../../Browse/feature/ability/talent/level-1/feedback-loop.md), [Remote Assistance](../../Browse/feature/ability/talent/level-1/remote-assistance.md) |

##### Accelerate {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/accelerate"}

You have the following ability.

###### Accelerate {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-1/accelerate"}


*To your ally, it seems as though the world has slowed down.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |                **Maneuver** |
|---------------------|----------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**    | **🎯 Self or one creature** |

**Effect:** The target shifts up to a number of squares equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score.

**Spend 2 Clarity:** The target can use a maneuver.

##### Again {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/again"}

You have the following ability.

###### Again {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-1/again"}


*You step back a split second to see if things play out a little differently.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |               **Triggered** |
|---------------------|----------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**    | **🎯 Self or one creature** |

**Trigger:** The target makes an [ability roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/ability-roll.md).

**Effect:** You can use this ability after seeing the result of the triggering roll. The target must reroll the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) and use the new roll.

##### Feedback Loop {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/feedback-loop"}

You have the following ability.

###### Feedback Loop {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-1/feedback-loop"}


*Creating a brief psychic link between an enemy and their target gives that foe a taste of their own medicine.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |       **Triggered** |
|---------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**    | **🎯 One creature** |

**Trigger:** The target deals damage to an ally.

**Effect:** The target takes psychic damage equal to half the triggering damage.

##### Minor Telekinesis {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/minor-telekinesis"}

You have the following ability.

###### Minor Telekinesis {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-1/minor-telekinesis"}


*Wisps of psychic energy ripple visibly from your brain as you force the target to move using only your mind.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |                                 **Maneuver** |
|---------------------|---------------------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**    | **🎯 Self or one [size](../../Browse/rule/character/size.md) 1 creature or object** |

**Effect:** You [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) the target up to a number of squares equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score.

**Spend 2+ Clarity:** The size of the creature or object you can target increases by 1 for every 2 clarity spent.

**Spend 3 Clarity:** You can vertical [slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) the target.

You have the following ability.

*An ally gains the benefit of your intellect.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |                  **Maneuver** |
|---------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**    | **🎯 One creature or object** |


**Effect:** The next [ability roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/ability-roll.md) an ally makes against the target before the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) gains an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md).

#### Repel {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/repel"}

You have the following ability.

##### Repel {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-1/repel"}


*They aren't going anywhere, but you might!*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |           **Triggered** |
|---------------------|------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**    | **🎯 Self or one ally** |

**Trigger:** The target takes damage or is [force moved](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md).

**Effect:** The target takes half the triggering damage, or the [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) of the triggering [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) is reduced by a number of squares equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score. If the target took damage and was force moved, you choose the effect. If the [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) is reduced to 0 squares, the target can [push](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) the source of the [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) a number of squares equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score.

#### Talent Abilities {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-1/talent-abilities"}

You manifest a variety of psionic powers that let you impact the environment, bolster your allies, and empower yourself. You can choose abilities across different [talent tradition](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/talent-tradition.md)s or focus on abilities tied to your chosen tradition to dedicate yourself to its power.

##### Signature Abilities

Choose two [signature abilities](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) from the following options. [Signature abilities](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) can be used at will. (*Quick Build:* [Incinerate](../../Browse/feature/ability/talent/level-1/incinerate.md), [Kinetic Grip](../../Browse/feature/ability/talent/level-1/kinetic-grip.md).)

###### Entropic Bolt {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-1/entropic-bolt"}


*You advance an enemy's age for a moment.*

| **Chronopathy, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md)** |               **Main action** |
|------------------------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                         | **🎯 One creature or object** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md):**

- **≤11:** 2 + P corruption damage; P < WEAK, [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends)
- **12-16:** 3 + P corruption damage; P < AVERAGE, [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends)
- **17+:** 5 + P corruption damage; P < STRONG, [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends)

**Effect:** The target takes an extra 1 corruption damage for each additional time they are targeted by this ability during the encounter.

**Strained:** You gain 1 clarity when you obtain a tier 2 or tier 3 outcome on the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md).

###### Hoarfrost {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-1/hoarfrost"}


*You blast a foe with a pulse of cold energy.*

| **Cryokinesis, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**, **Strike** |     **Main action** |
|----------------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                             | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** 2 + R cold damage; M < WEAK, [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) ([EoT](../../Browse/rule/combat/end-of-turn.md))
- **12-16:** 4 + R cold damage; M < AVERAGE, [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) ([EoT](../../Browse/rule/combat/end-of-turn.md))
- **17+:** 6 + R cold damage; M < STRONG, [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) ([EoT](../../Browse/rule/combat/end-of-turn.md))

**Strained:** You are [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) until the end of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md). Additionally, a target [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) by this ability is [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) instead.

###### Incinerate {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-1/incinerate"}

**Strained:** The size of the [cube](../../Browse/rule/combat/cube.md) increases by 2, but the fire disappears at the end of your [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

###### Inertia Soak {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-1/inertia-soak"}


*Your psionic energy surrounds the target and pushes everything else away from them.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), Telekinesis** |            **Maneuver** |
|----------------------------------|------------------------:|

**Effect:** The target ignores [difficult terrain](../../Browse/movement/difficult-terrain.md) and takes no damage from [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) until the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md). Whenever the target enters a square while under this effect, they can [push](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) one [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) creature up to a number of squares equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score. When [pushing](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) an ally, the target can ignore that ally's [stability](../../Browse/rule/character/stability.md). A creature can only be force moved this way once a [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

While you are [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) this way, whenever you are force moved, the [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) gains a +5 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md).

This [stability](../../Browse/rule/character/stability.md) increase lasts until the target no longer has [temporary Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina.md) from this ability.

**Effect:** Until the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), the target gains a +3 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md), and they have a double [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on the next [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) they make. If the target obtains a tier 3 outcome on that roll, you gain 1 clarity.
