### 2nd-Level Features

As a 2nd-level [talent](../../Browse/class/talent.md), you gain the following features.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-2/perk"}

You gain one interpersonal, lore, or [supernatural](../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural.md) perk of your choice. See Chapter 7: [Perks](perks.md).

#### 2nd-Level Tradition Feature {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-2/2nd-level-tradition-feature"}

Your [talent tradition](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/talent-tradition.md) grants you a feature, as shown on the 2nd-Level Tradition Features table.

###### 2nd-Level Tradition Features Table

| Tradition                    | Features        |
|------------------------------|-----------------|
| Chronopathy                  | [Ease the Hours](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-2/ease-the-hours.md)  |
| Telekinesis                  | [Ease Their Fall](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-2/ease-their-fall.md) |
| Telepathy                    | [Ease the Mind](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-2/ease-the-mind.md)   |

##### Ease the Hours {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-2/ease-the-hours"}

You can increase the number of rounds in a [montage test](../../Browse/rule/test/montage-test.md) by 1 if the [test](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md) would end before the heroes hit the success limit.

##### Ease the Mind {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-2/ease-the-mind"}

You gain an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on [tests](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md) made to stop combat and start a negotiation. Additionally, if you are present during a negotiation, any [NPC](../../Browse/rule/general/npc.md) who has a hostile or suspicious starting attitude has their patience increased by 1 (to a maximum of 5).

##### Ease Their Fall {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-2/ease-their-fall"}

Whenever you land after a fall, or if any falling creature lands within 2 squares of you, you can use a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) to reduce the falling damage by an amount equal to 2 + your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score.

#### 2nd-Level Tradition Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-2/2nd-level-tradition-ability"}

Your [talent tradition](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/talent-tradition.md) grants your choice of one of two [heroic abilities](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md).

##### 2nd-Level Chronopathy Ability

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Applied Chronometrics {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-2/applied-chronometrics"}


*Time slows down around you. Your heartbeat is the only gauge of the extra moments you've gained.*

| **Chronopathy, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |   **Maneuver** |
|----------------------------------|---------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                 | **🎯 Special** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md):**

- **≤11:** You target two creatures, one of which can be you.
- **12-16:** You target three creatures, one of which can be you.
- **17+:** You target four creatures, one of which can be you.

**Effect:** Until the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), each target gains a +5 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md), they can't be made [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md), and they can use an additional maneuver on their [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md). If a target is already [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md), that [condition](../../Browse/rule/combat/condition.md) ends for them.

**Strained:** Your [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) is halved until the end of the encounter.

###### Slow {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-2/slow"}


*Perhaps they wonder why everyone else is moving so quickly?*

| **Chronopathy, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |                      **Maneuver** |
|----------------------------------|----------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                 | **🎯 Three creatures or objects** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md):**

- **≤11:** The target's [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) is halved (save ends), or if P < WEAK, the target is [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends).
- **12-16:** The target is [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends), or if P < AVERAGE, the target's [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) is 0 (save ends).
- **17+:** The target is [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends), or if P < STRONG, the target's [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) is 0 (save ends).

**Effect:** A target can't use [triggered actions](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) while their [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) is reduced this way.

**Strained:** The [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) of this ability increases by 1 and you take 1d6 damage. At the start of each [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) while any target is affected by this ability, you take 1d6 damage. You can end the effect on all affected targets at any time (no action required).

##### 2nd-Level Telekinesis Ability

Choose one of the following abilities.

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **12-16:** 6 damage; vertical [push](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 4
- **17+:** 9 damage; vertical [push](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 6

**Strained:** The size of the [burst](../../Browse/rule/combat/burst.md) increases by 1, and you are [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) until the end of your [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

###### Levity and Gravity {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-2/levity-and-gravity"}


*You raise the target slightly into the air, then smother them against the ground.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Telekinesis** |               **Main action** |
|------------------------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                         | **🎯 One creature or object** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** 6 + R damage; M < WEAK[, prone](../../Browse/condition/prone.md)
- **12-16:** 10 + R damage; M < AVERAGE[, prone](../../Browse/condition/prone.md)
- **17+:** 14 + R damage; M < STRONG, [prone and](../../Browse/condition/prone.md) can't stand (save ends)

##### 2nd-Level Telepathy Ability

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Overwhelm {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-2/overwhelm"}


*You overload their senses, turning all their subconscious thoughts into conscious ones.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Telepathy** |     **Main action** |
|----------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                       | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** 6 + R psychic damage; I < WEAK, [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends)
- **12-16:** 10 + R psychic damage; I < AVERAGE, [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) (save ends)
- **17+:** 14 + R psychic damage; I < STRONG, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends)

**Strained:** You start crying, and you can't use [triggered actions](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) or make [free strikes](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) until the end of the target's next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

###### Synaptic Override {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-2/synaptic-override"}


*You control an enemy's nervous system. How pleasant for them.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), Telepathy** |  **Main action** |
|--------------------------------|-----------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**               | **🎯 One enemy** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** The target makes a [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) against one enemy of your choice.
- **12-16:** The target shifts up to their [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) and uses their [signature ability](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) against any enemies of your choice.
- **17+:** The target moves up to their [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) and uses their [signature ability](../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability.md) against any enemies of your choice.

**Effect:** You control the target's movement. The target can't be moved in a way that would harm them (such as over a cliff), leave them [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md), or result in them suffering a [condition](../../Browse/rule/combat/condition.md) or other negative effect. However, you can move them to provoke [opportunity attacks](../../Browse/rule/combat/opportunity-attack.md).

**Strained:** You take 1d6 damage and are [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) until the end of your [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

### 3rd-Level Features

As a 3rd-level [talent](../../Browse/class/talent.md), you gain the following features.

#### Scan {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-3/scan"}

You can extend your psionic senses beyond their usual range. Once on each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), you can search for hidden creatures as a [free maneuver](../../Browse/rule/combat/free-maneuver.md) (see Hide and Sneak in Chapter 9: [Tests](tests.md)). Additionally, once you establish [line of effect](../../Browse/rule/combat/line-of-effect.md) to a thinking creature within [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) of your [Mind Spike](../../Browse/feature/ability/talent/level-1/mind-spike.md) ability, you always have [line of effect](../../Browse/rule/combat/line-of-effect.md) to that creature until they move beyond that [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md).

#### 7-Clarity Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-3/7-clarity-ability"}

Choose one [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) from the following options, each of which costs 7 clarity to use.

##### Fling Through Time {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-3/fling-through-time"}


*You hurl the target through the annals of time, forcing them to witness every moment of their existence all at once.*

| **Chronopathy, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**, **Strike** |               **Main action** |
|----------------------------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                             | **🎯 One creature or object** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md):**

- **≤11:** 3 + P corruption damage; P < WEAK, [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) (save ends)
- **12-16:** 5 + P corruption damage; the target is flung through time, and if P < AVERAGE, they are [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) (save ends)
- **17+:** 8 + P corruption damage; the target is flung through time, and if P < STRONG, they are [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) (save ends)

**Effect:** A target who is flung through time is removed from the encounter map until the end of their next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), reappearing in their original space or the nearest unoccupied space.

**Strained:** You take 2d6 damage and permanently grow visibly older (the equivalent of 10 years for a [human](../../Browse/ancestry/human.md)). If you obtain a tier 3 outcome on the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md), you gain 2 clarity.

##### Force Orbs {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-3/force-orbs"}


*Spheres of solid psionic energy float around you.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Telekinesis** | **Main action** |
|------------------------------------------|----------------:|
| **📏 Self; see below**                   |     **🎯 Self** |

**Effect:** You create three [size](../../Browse/rule/character/size.md) 1T orbs that orbit your body. Each orb gives you a cumulative [damage immunity](../../Browse/rule/damage/damage-immunity.md) 1. Each time you take damage, you lose 1 orb.

Once on each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), you can use a [free maneuver](../../Browse/rule/combat/free-maneuver.md) to fire an orb at a creature or object within 5 squares as a [ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), losing the orb after the [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md).

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** 2 damage
- **12-16:** 3 damage
- **17+:** 5 damage

**Strained:** You create five orbs, and you are [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) while you have any orbs active.

##### Reflector Field {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-3/reflector-field"}


*A protective field reverses the momentum of incoming attacks.*

| **Area, Psionic, Telepathy** | **Main action** |
|------------------------------|----------------:|
| **📏 3 [aura](../../Browse/rule/combat/aura.md)**                |  **🎯 Special** |

**Effect:** The [aura](../../Browse/rule/combat/aura.md) lasts until the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md). Whenever an enemy targets an ally in the area with a [ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) ability, the ability is negated on the ally and reflected back at the enemy. The ability deals half the damage to the enemy that it would have dealt to the ally and loses any additional effects.

**Strained:** The size of the [aura](../../Browse/rule/combat/aura.md) increases by 1. Whenever your [aura](../../Browse/rule/combat/aura.md) reflects an ability, you take 2d6 damage and forget a memory, as determined by you and the Director.

##### Soul Burn {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-3/soul-burn"}


*You blast their soul out of their body, leaving it to helplessly float back to a weakened husk.*

| **Animapathy, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**, **Strike** |     **Main action** |
|---------------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                            | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md):**

- **≤11:** 6 + P damage; P < WEAK, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends)
- **12-16:** 10 + P damage; P < AVERAGE, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends)
- **17+:** 14 + P damage; P < STRONG, [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md) (save ends)

**Effect:** The target takes a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md) [tests](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md) until the end of the encounter.

**Strained:** The [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) of this ability increases by 1. You take 2d6 damage and gain 3 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md) that you can use immediately.

### 4th-Level Features

As a 4th-level [talent](../../Browse/class/talent.md), you gain the following features.

#### Characteristic Increase {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-4/characteristic-increase"}

Your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) and [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md) scores each increase to 3.

#### Mind Projection {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-4/mind-projection"}

As a maneuver, you project your mind outside your body. While you are in this state, your body remains unconscious [and prone](../../Browse/condition/prone.md), and your mind is a separate entity with [size](../../Browse/rule/character/size.md) 1T. Your mind automatically has [concealment](../../Browse/rule/combat/concealment.md), and can freely move through solid matter. If you end your [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) inside solid matter, you are forced out into the space where you entered it.

Any abilities or features you use originate from your mind. Both your mind and your body can take damage while separated, with any such damage applied to your [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md). Your mind is instantly forced back into your body if you take any damage, and you can immediately return to your body as a [free maneuver](../../Browse/rule/combat/free-maneuver.md).

#### Mind Recovery {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-4/mind-recovery"}

Whenever you spend a [Recovery](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md) to regain [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) while strained, you can forgo the [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) and gain 3 clarity instead.

Additionally, the first time each [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) that a creature is [force moved](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md), you gain 2 clarity instead of 1.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-4/perk"}

You gain one perk of your choice.

#### Skill {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-4/skill"}

You gain one skill of your choice. See Skills in Chapter 9: [Tests](tests.md).

#### Suspensor Field {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-4/suspensor-field"}

You can [fly](../../Browse/movement/fly.md). While [flying](../../Browse/movement/fly.md), your [stability](../../Browse/rule/character/stability.md) is reduced to 0 and can't be increased. If you can already [fly](../../Browse/movement/fly.md), you have a +2 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) while [flying](../../Browse/movement/fly.md) instead.

If you are strained while [flying](../../Browse/movement/fly.md) and are force moved, the [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) gains a +2 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md).

### 5th-Level Features

As a 5th-level [talent](../../Browse/class/talent.md), you gain the following features.

#### 5th-Level Tradition Features {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-5/5th-level-tradition-features"}

Your [talent tradition](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/talent-tradition.md) grants you two features, as shown on the 5th-Level Tradition Features table.

###### 5th-Level Tradition Features Table

| Tradition   | Features                              |
|-------------|---------------------------------------|
| Chronopathy | [Distortion Temporal](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-5/distortion-temporal.md), [Speed of Thought](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-5/speed-of-thought.md) |
| Telekinesis | [Kinetic Amplifier](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-5/kinetic-amplifier.md), [Triangulate](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-5/triangulate.md)        |
| Telepathy   | [Compulsion](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-5/compulsion.md), [Remote Amplification](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-5/remote-amplification.md)      |

##### Compulsion {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-5/compulsion"}

Whenever you obtain a success on a [test](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md) using a skill from the [interpersonal skill group](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/interpersonal.md) while interacting with an [NPC](../../Browse/rule/general/npc.md), you can ask them a question using your [Telepathic Speech](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/telepathic-speech.md) feature. The [NPC](../../Browse/rule/general/npc.md) must answer the question truthfully to the best of their ability.

##### Distortion Temporal {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-5/distortion-temporal"}

While you are not [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md), time behaves irregularly around you in a 3 [aura](../../Browse/rule/combat/aura.md). That area is [difficult terrain](../../Browse/movement/difficult-terrain.md) for enemies. Additionally, when an ally enters the area for the first time in a [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) or starts their turn there, they gain a +2 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) until the end of the [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

##### Kinetic Amplifier {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-5/kinetic-amplifier"}

Whenever you force move a creature, you can spend up to 2 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md). For each [surge](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md) spent, the [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) gains a [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score.

##### Remote Amplification {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-5/remote-amplification"}

The [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) of your [ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) psionic abilities increases by 5. Additionally, the range of your [Telepathic Speech](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/telepathic-speech.md) feature increases to 1 mile.

##### Speed of Thought {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-5/speed-of-thought"}

Once per [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) while you are not [dying](../../Browse/rule/health/dying.md), you can spend 2 clarity when you use a [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) to [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) it into a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md).

##### Triangulate {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-5/triangulate"}

Whenever an ally uses a [ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) ability while you are within the ability's [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md), you can spend 1 clarity as a free [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) to allow them to use the ability as if they were in your space.

#### 9-Clarity Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-5/9-clarity-ability"}

Choose one [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) from the following options, each of which costs 9 clarity to use.

##### Exothermic Shield {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-5/exothermic-shield"}


*You encase the target in psionic flame and allow them to flicker without fear of burning out.*

| **Pyrokinesis, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |            **Maneuver** |
|----------------------------------|------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                 | **🎯 Self or one ally** |

**Effect:** Until the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), the target has cold immunity 10 and fire immunity 10, and their [strikes](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) deal extra fire damage equal to twice your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score. Additionally, whenever an enemy uses a [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) ability against the target while they are under this effect, the enemy takes 5 fire damage.

**Strained:** The target gains 2 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md). You are [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) and [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends).

##### Hypersonic {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-5/hypersonic"}


*You move fast enough to [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) around and watch your foes feel the aftermath.*

| **Area, Charge, Psionic, Telekinesis** |               **Main action** |
|----------------------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 5 x 2 line within 1**             | **🎯 Each enemy in the area** |

**Effect:** You [teleport](../../Browse/movement/teleport.md) to a square on the opposite side of the area before making the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md).

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** 12 sonic damage
- **12-16:** 18 sonic damage
- **17+:** 24 sonic damage

**Strained:** If you obtain a tier 2 outcome or better, you are [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) until the end of your [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) and each target is [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) until the end of their [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

##### Mind Snare {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-5/mind-snare"}


*You latch onto your prey's brain and don't let go, like a song they can't get out of their head.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Telepathy** |     **Main action** |
|----------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                       | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** 10 + R psychic damage; R < WEAK, [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends)
- **12-16:** 14 + R psychic damage; R < AVERAGE, [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends)
- **17+:** 20 + R psychic damage; R < STRONG, [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends)

**Effect:** While [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) this way, the target takes 3 psychic damage for each square they willingly leave.

**Strained:** While [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) this way, the target instead takes 5 psychic damage for each square they willingly leave. You have a double [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on [ability rolls](../../Browse/rule/dice/ability-roll.md) made against the target while they are [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) this way.

##### Soulbound {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-5/soulbound"}


*You fire a piercing bolt of psychic energy that lances through two foes and leaves a faint intangible thread between them.*

| **Animapathy, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md)** |    **Main action** |
|-----------------------------------------|-------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                        | **🎯 Two enemies** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md):**

- **≤11:** 8 damage; A < WEAK, the target is stitched to the other target (save ends)
- **12-16:** 13 damage; A < AVERAGE, the target is stitched to the other target (save ends)
- **17+:** 17 damage; A < STRONG, the target is stitched to the other target (save ends)

**Effect:** If any target becomes stitched to the other, both targets are stitched together. While stitched together, a target takes a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on [power rolls](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) while not [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) to a creature they're stitched to. Whenever a stitched target takes damage that wasn't dealt by or also taken by another stitched target, each other stitched target takes half the damage the initial target took.

**Strained:** You target yourself and three enemies instead.

### 6th-Level Features

As a 6th-level [talent](../../Browse/class/talent.md), you gain the following features.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-6/perk"}

You gain one interpersonal, lore, or [supernatural](../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural.md) perk of your choice.

#### Psi Boost {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-6/psi-boost"}

Whenever you use an ability that is a main action or a maneuver with the Psionic keyword, you can spend additional discipline to apply a [psi boost](../../Browse/feature/null/level-7/psi-boost.md) to it and enhance its effects. A [psi boost](../../Browse/feature/null/level-7/psi-boost.md)'s effects only last until the end of the [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) which the ability is first used. You can apply multiple psi boosts to an ability, but only one instance of each specific boost. You can use the following psi boosts.

##### Dynamic Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-6/dynamic-power"}

If the ability force moves a target, the [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) gains a [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score.

##### Expanded Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-6/expanded-power"}

If the ability targets an area, you increase the size of the area by 1. If the area is a line, you increase the size of one dimension, not both.

##### Extended Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-6/extended-power"}

If the ability is [ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), the [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) gains a [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score. If the ability is [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), the [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) gains a +2 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md).

##### Heightened Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-6/heightened-power"}

If the ability deals [rolled damage](../../Browse/rule/damage/rolled-damage.md), it deals extra damage equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score.

##### Magnified Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-6/magnified-power"}

If the ability has a [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md), you increase that [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) by an amount equal to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score.

##### Shared Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-6/shared-power"}

If the ability targets individual creatures or objects, you target one additional creature or object within [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md).

##### Sharpened Power {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-6/sharpened-power"}

If the ability has any [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md), that roll gains an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md).

#### 6th-Level Tradition Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-6/6th-level-tradition-ability"}

Your [talent tradition](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/talent-tradition.md) grants your choice of one of two [heroic abilities](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md).

##### 6th-Level Chronopathy Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Fate {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-6/fate"}


*Your foe gets a glimpse of how it will end for them.*

| **Chronopathy, Psionic, [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md)** |  **Main action** |
|---------------------------------|-----------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 2**                  | **🎯 One enemy** |

**Effect:** The target has [damage weakness](../../Browse/rule/damage/damage-weakness.md) 5 until the end of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md). Whenever the target takes damage while they have this weakness, they are [knocked prone](../../Browse/condition/prone.md).

**Strained:** This ability gains the [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md) keyword as the vision hurts the target's psyche. You make a [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md), then are [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) (save ends).

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md):**

- **≤11:** 8 + P psychic damage
- **12-16:** 13 + P psychic damage
- **17+:** 17 + P psychic damage

###### Stasis Field {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-6/stasis-field"}


*Keep everything as it was. Ignore everything that will be.*

| **Area, Chronopathy, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |                             **Main action** |
|----------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------:|
| **📏 4 [cube](../../Browse/rule/combat/cube.md) within 10**                | **🎯 Each creature and object in the area** |

**Effect:** The area is frozen in time until the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md). Each object in the area is [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) and can't fall until the effect ends. Until the effect ends, creatures in the area who are reduced to 0 [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) or would die stay alive, and objects in the area that are reduced to 0 [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) remain undestroyed.

Make a [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) that targets each enemy in the area.

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md):**

- **≤11:** P < WEAK, the target is [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) until the effect ends
- **12-16:** P < AVERAGE, the target's [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) is 0 until the effect ends
- **17+:** P < STRONG, the target is [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) until the effect ends

**Strained:** Any creature or object [force moved](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) in the area takes 2 corruption damage for each square of the area they enter. Creatures and objects [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) in the area can be [force moved](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md). You are [restrained](../../Browse/condition/restrained.md) until the effect ends.

##### 6th-Level Telekinesis Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Gravitic Well {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-6/gravitic-well"}


*You bend gravity into a fine point and pull your foes toward it.*

| **Area, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), Telekinesis** |                             **Main action** |
|----------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------:|
| **📏 4 [cube](../../Browse/rule/combat/cube.md) within 10**                | **🎯 Each creature and object in the area** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** 6 damage; vertical [pull](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 5 toward the center of the area
- **12-16:** 9 damage; vertical [pull](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 7 toward the center of the area
- **17+:** 13 damage; vertical [pull](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 10 toward the center of the area

**Effect:** Targets closest to the center of the area are [pulled](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) first.

**Strained:** The size of the area increases by 2. You also target yourself and each ally within [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md).

###### Greater Kinetic Grip {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-6/greater-kinetic-grip"}


*You raise the target into the air without breaking a sweat.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**, **Strike, Telekinesis** |               **Main action** |
|----------------------------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                             | **🎯 One creature or object** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** [Slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 4 + R; M < WEAK, the [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) is vertical
- **12-16:** [Slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 8 + R; M < AVERAGE, the [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) is vertical
- **17+:** [Slide](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) 12 + R; [prone](../../Browse/condition/prone.md); M < STRONG, the [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) is vertical

**Strained:** The [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) ignores [stability](../../Browse/rule/character/stability.md). You take 2d6 damage and are [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) (save ends).

##### 6th-Level Telepathy Abilities

Choose one of the following abilities.

###### Synaptic Conditioning {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-6/synaptic-conditioning"}


*It's a subtle mindset shift. It's not that they're your enemy—you just don't like them!*

| **Psionic, [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md)**, **Strike, Telepathy** |     **Main action** |
|-------------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 2**                            | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** 10 psychic damage; the target takes a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on [ability rolls](../../Browse/rule/dice/ability-roll.md) made to harm you or your allies (save ends)
- **12-16:** 14 psychic damage; the target has a double [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on [ability rolls](../../Browse/rule/dice/ability-roll.md) made to harm you or your allies (save ends)
- **17+:** 20 psychic damage; the target considers you and your allies to be their allies when using abilities and features (save ends)

**Strained:** While the target is under this effect, you no longer consider your enemies to be your enemies when using your abilities and features.

###### Synaptic Dissipation {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-6/synaptic-dissipation"}


*You manipulate your enemies' minds and make them wonder if you were ever really there in the first place.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md), [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Telepathy** |   **Maneuver** |
|----------------------------------------|---------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                       | **🎯 Special** |

**Effect:** You target a number of creatures with this ability determined by the outcome of your [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md). You and your allies are invisible to each target until the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** Two creatures
- **12-16:** Three creatures
- **17+:** Five creatures

**Strained:** The effect ends early if you take damage from an enemy's ability.

### 7th-Level Features

As a 7th-level [talent](../../Browse/class/talent.md), you gain the following features.

#### Ancestral Memory {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-7/ancestral-memory"}

Each time you finish a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md), you can choose a number of skills you have up to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score and replace them with an equal number of skills from the [interpersonal](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/interpersonal.md) and [lore](../../Browse/skill/lore/lore.md) skill groups. These replacements last until the end of your next [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md).

#### Cascading Strain {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-7/cascading-strain"}

Whenever you take damage from a strained effect or from having negative clarity, you can choose one enemy within [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) of your [Mind Spike](../../Browse/feature/ability/talent/level-1/mind-spike.md) ability to take the same damage.

#### Characteristic Increase {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-7/characteristic-increase"}

Each of your [characteristic](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md) scores increases by 1, to a maximum of 4.

#### Lucid Mind {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-7/lucid-mind"}

At the start of each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) during combat, you gain 1d3 + 1 clarity instead of 1d3.

#### Skill {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-7/skill"}

You gain one skill of your choice.

### 8th-Level Features

As an 8th-level [talent](../../Browse/class/talent.md), you gain the following features.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-8/perk"}

You gain one perk of your choice.

#### 8th-Level Tradition Features {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-8/8th-level-tradition-features"}

Your [talent tradition](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/talent-tradition.md) grants you two features, as shown on the 8th-Level Tradition Features table.

###### 8th-Level Tradition Features Table

| Tradition   | Features                          |
|-------------|-----------------------------------|
| Chronopathy | [Doubling the Hours](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-8/doubling-the-hours.md), [Stasis Shield](../../Browse/feature/ability/talent/level-8/stasis-shield.md) |
| Telekinesis | [Levitation Field](../../Browse/feature/ability/talent/level-8/levitation-field.md), [Low Gravity](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-8/low-gravity.md)     |
| Telepathy   | [Mindlink](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-8/mindlink.md), [Universal Connection](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-8/universal-connection.md)    |

##### Doubling the Hours {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-8/doubling-the-hours"}

While you have 5 or more [Victories](../../Browse/rule/resource/victories.md), you can undertake an additional [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md) activity during a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md).

##### Levitation Field {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-8/levitation-field"}

You have the following ability.

###### Levitation Field {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-8/levitation-field"}


*You manipulate the air around your allies so they can move as freely through the sky as you can.*

| **Area, Psionic** |                 **Maneuver** |
|-------------------|-----------------------------:|
| **📏 3 [burst](../../Browse/rule/combat/burst.md)**    | **🎯 Each ally in the area** |

**Effect:** Each target can [fly](../../Browse/movement/fly.md) until the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), and can immediately [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) up to their [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md). You can also [shift](../../Browse/movement/shifting.md) up to your [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md). While [flying](../../Browse/movement/fly.md), a target's [stability](../../Browse/rule/character/stability.md) is reduced to 0 and can't be increased.

**Spend 5 Clarity:** The effects last for 1 hour instead.

##### Low Gravity {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-8/low-gravity"}

Your mind can carry your body through tough times. You ignore [difficult terrain](../../Browse/movement/difficult-terrain.md) and don't need to spend additional movement [while prone](../../Browse/condition/prone.md).

##### Mindlink {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-8/mindlink"}

During a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md), you can choose a number of creatures up to your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) score who you have communicated with using your [Telepathic Speech](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/telepathic-speech.md) feature, creating a telepathic link among all of you. Whenever a linked creature spends one or more [Recoveries](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md), each other linked creature can spend a [Recovery](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md).

#### Stasis Shield {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-8/stasis-shield"}

You have the following ability.

##### Stasis Shield {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-8/stasis-shield"}


*You freeze time just long enough to bring the victim to safety!*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |                          **Triggered** |
|---------------------|---------------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**    | **🎯 Self, or one creature or object** |

**Trigger:** The target takes damage.

**Effect:** The target is [teleport](../../Browse/movement/teleport.md)ed to an unoccupied space [adjacent](../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent.md) to you, taking no damage and suffering no additional effects if this movement would get them out of harm's way.

**Strained:** You can't target yourself, and you take the damage and any additional effects instead of the target.

#### Universal Connection {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-8/universal-connection"}

The range of your [Telepathic Speech](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/telepathic-speech.md) feature increases to anywhere on the same world.

#### 11-Clarity Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-8/11-clarity-ability"}

Choose one [heroic ability](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) from the following options, each of which costs 11 clarity to use.

##### Doubt {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-8/doubt"}


*You tug at the strings of the foe's anima and unravel them, allowing someone else to take advantage of their drive.*

| **Animapathy, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**, **Strike** |               **Main action** |
|---------------------------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                            | **🎯 One creature or object** |

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md):**

- **≤11:** 10 + P damage; P < WEAK, [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) (save ends)
- **12-16:** 14 + P damage; P < AVERAGE, [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) (save ends)
- **17+:** 20 + P damage; P < STRONG, [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) and [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) (save ends)

After you make the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md), you or one ally within [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) have a double [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on the next [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) you make before the end of the encounter.

**Strained:** You feel dispirited until you finish a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md). If you obtain a tier 3 outcome on the [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md), you and the target each have [damage weakness](../../Browse/rule/damage/damage-weakness.md) 5 (save ends).

##### Mindwipe {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-8/mindwipe"}


*You attempt to make them forget all their training.*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md), Psionic, [Strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md), Telepathy** |     **Main action** |
|---------------------------------------|--------------------:|

**[Power Roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) + [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md):**

- **≤11:** 12 + R damage; R < WEAK, the target takes a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on their next [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md)
- **12-16:** 17 + R damage; R < AVERAGE, the target takes a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on [power rolls](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) (save ends)
- **17+:** 23 + R damage; R < STRONG, the target has a double [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on [power rolls](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) (save ends)

**Effect:** The target can't communicate with anyone until the end of the encounter.

**Strained:** You take 3d6 damage.

##### Rejuvenate {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-8/rejuvenate"}


*You reshape the flow of time in the target's body to return it to an earlier state.*

| **Chronopathy, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |            **Maneuver** |

- The target gains 1 of their [Heroic Resource](../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource.md), and can end any effects on them that are ended by a [saving throw](../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw.md) or that end at the end of their [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).
- The target gains 2 [surges](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md), and gains a +3 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to [speed](../../Browse/rule/character/speed.md) until the end of the encounter.

##### Steel {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-8/steel"}


*The target's skin becomes covered in tough metal.*

| **Metamorphosis, Psionic, [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)** |            **Maneuver** |
|------------------------------------|------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10**                   | **🎯 Self or one ally** |

**Effect:** The target has [damage immunity](../../Browse/rule/damage/damage-immunity.md) 5 and can't be made [slowed](../../Browse/condition/slowed.md) or [weakened](../../Browse/condition/weakened.md) until the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md). Whenever the target force moves a creature or object while under this effect, the [forced movement](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md) [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) gains a +5 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md).

**Strained:** You can't use maneuvers (save ends).

### 9th-Level Features

As a 9th-level [talent](../../Browse/class/talent.md), you gain the following features.

#### Fortress of Perfect Thought {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-9/fortress-of-perfect-thought"}

Your mind is an impenetrable palace that shields you from danger. You gain the following effects:

- You can breathe even when there is no breathable air.
- You have psychic immunity 10.
- Creatures can't read your thoughts unless you allow them to.
- Your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) and [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) are treated as 2 higher for the purpose of resisting the [potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md) of abilities.
- You can't be made [taunted](../../Browse/condition/taunted.md) or [frightened](../../Browse/condition/frightened.md).

#### 9th-Level Tradition Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-9/9th-level-tradition-ability"}

Your [talent tradition](../../Browse/feature/talent/level-1/talent-tradition.md) grants your choice of one of two [heroic abilities](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md).

##### 9th-Level Chronopathy Abilities

A target can't gain more than 3 of their [Heroic Resource](../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource.md) this way. After using this ability, you can't gain any clarity until the end of the next [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md).

### 10th-Level Features

As a 10th-level [talent](../../Browse/class/talent.md), you gain the following features.

#### Characteristic Increase {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-10/characteristic-increase"}

Your [Reason](../../Browse/rule/character/reason.md) and [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md) scores each increase to 5.

#### Clear Mind {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-10/clear-mind"}

The first time each [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) that a creature is [force moved](../../Browse/movement/forced-movement.md), you gain 3 clarity instead of 2.

#### Omnisensory {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-10/omnisensory"}

You have a +10 [bonus](../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md) to the [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) of your [ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) abilities. Additionally, you don't need [line of effect](../../Browse/rule/combat/line-of-effect.md) to a target of a [ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) ability if the target is a creature capable of thought who you have previously had [line of effect](../../Browse/rule/combat/line-of-effect.md) to.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-10/perk"}

You gain one interpersonal, lore, or [supernatural](../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural.md) perk of your choice.

#### Psion {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-10/psion"}

At the start of each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) during combat, you gain 1d3 + 2 clarity instead of 1d3 + 1.

Additionally, you can choose to not take damage from having negative clarity. You can also choose to take on any ability's strained effect even if you're not strained.

#### Skill {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-10/skill"}

You gain one skill of your choice.

#### Vision {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.talent.level-10/vision"}

You have an epic resource called vision. Each time you finish a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md), you gain vision equal to the [XP](../../Browse/rule/resource/experience.md) you gain. You can spend vision on your abilities as if it were clarity.

Additionally, you can spend vision to use one additional psionic ability on your [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), provided you pay the entire cost of the ability in vision. If you choose to use a psionic ability that usually costs no clarity, you must spend 1 vision to use it.

Vision remains until you spend it.

## Troubadour {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/class/troubadour"}

The whole world's a stage, and everyone on it, an actor. No one knows this better than the [troubadour](../../Browse/class/troubadour.md). You find energy in the drama of everyday life and know how to draw spectacle forth from even the most mundane of situations. You accent highs and deepen lows in service to whoever might witness your performance.

**As a [troubadour](../../Browse/class/troubadour.md), you chase drama. The insurmountable dangers of the world might cause many a hero to cower. But you take to that world stage not intending to die, but to find out if you are truly alive.**

"History is a tale. Each of us is just a story we tell ourselves. Change the story, and you change the world." **Jackson Bootblack**

There is no visible text in the image provided. The image appears to show a decorative or scalloped [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) pattern, but contains no recognizable letters, words, or symbols.

### Basics

**Starting [Characteristics](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md):** You start with an [Agility](../../Browse/rule/character/agility.md) of 2 and a [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md) of 2, and you can choose one of the following arrays for your other [characteristic](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md) scores:

- 2, −1, −1
- 1, 1, −1
- 1, 0, 0

**Weak [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md) − 2

**Average [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md) − 1

**Strong [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Presence](../../Browse/rule/character/presence.md)

**Starting [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) at 1st Level:** 18

**[Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) Gained at 2nd and Higher Levels:** 6

**[Recoveries](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md):** 8

**Skills:** You gain the [Read Person](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/read-person.md) skill (see Skills in Chapter 9: [Tests](tests.md)). Then choose two skills from the [interpersonal skill group](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/interpersonal.md) and one skill from the [intrigue](../../Browse/skill/intrigue/intrigue.md) or [lore](../../Browse/skill/lore/lore.md) skill groups. (*Quick Build:* Brag, Flirt, [Read Person](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/read-person.md), Rumors.)

### 1st-Level Features

As a 1st-level [troubadour](../../Browse/class/troubadour.md), you gain the following features.

#### Troubadour Class Act {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.troubadour.level-1/troubadour-class-act"}

Panache, melody, and depiction. Some [troubadours](../../Browse/class/troubadour.md) have it all, but everyone starts somewhere. Your [troubadour class act](../../Browse/feature/troubadour/level-1/troubadour-class-act.md) is your art form, summing up the manner in which the world becomes your stage. As you go about unearthing the drama of everyday life and strife, you choose a [troubadour class act](../../Browse/feature/troubadour/level-1/troubadour-class-act.md) from the following options, each of which grants you a skill. (*Quick Build:* Virtuoso.)

- **Auteur:** You seek drama from story and recount, using your magic to manipulate the sequence of events unfolding before you. You have the [Brag](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/brag.md) skill.
- **Duelist:** Drama infuses your every movement done in tandem with another. You perform dances of death, putting trust in your opponent to return your passion in kind. You have the [Gymnastics](../../Browse/skill/exploration/gymnastics.md) skill.
- **Virtuoso:** You find drama in music and song, weaving magic between vibrations and filling the audience with your pathos. You have the [Music](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/music.md) skill and can play an instrument.

Your [troubadour class act](../../Browse/feature/troubadour/level-1/troubadour-class-act.md) is your [subclass](../../Browse/rule/general/subclass.md), and your choice of class act determines many of the features you'll gain as you gain new levels.

#### Drama {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.troubadour.level-1/drama"}

During battles, you are fueled by the dynamic ups, downs, and upside downs of the fray, from which you derive a [Heroic Resource](../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource.md) called drama.

##### Drama in Combat

At the start of a combat encounter or some other stressful situation tracked in [combat rounds](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md) (as determined by the Director), you gain drama equal to your [Victories](../../Browse/rule/resource/victories.md). At the start of each of your [turns](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md) during combat, you gain 1d3 drama.

Additionally, you gain drama when certain events occur during a combat encounter:

- The first time three or more heroes use an ability on the same [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md), you gain 2 drama.
- The first time any hero is made [winded](../../Browse/rule/health/winded.md) during the encounter, you gain 2 drama.
- Whenever a creature within your [line of effect](../../Browse/rule/combat/line-of-effect.md) rolls a [natural 19 or 20](../../Browse/rule/dice/natural-19-20.md), you gain 3 drama.
- When you or another hero dies, you gain 10 drama.

When you are dead, you continue to gain drama during combat as long as your body is intact. If you have 30 drama during the encounter in which you died, you can come back to life with 1 [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) and 0 drama (no action required). If you are still dead after the encounter in which you died, you can't gain drama during future encounters.

You lose any remaining drama at the end of the encounter.

##### Drama Outside of Combat

Though you can't gain drama outside of combat, you can use your [heroic abilities](../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability.md) and effects that cost drama without spending it. Whenever you use an ability or effect outside of combat that costs drama, you can't use that same ability or effect outside of combat again until you earn 1 or more [Victories](../../Browse/rule/resource/victories.md) or finish a [respite](../../Browse/rule/resource/respite.md).

When you use an ability outside of combat that lets you spend unlimited drama on its effect, such as [Artful Flourish](../../Browse/feature/ability/troubadour/level-1/artful-flourish.md), you can use it as if you had spent an amount of drama equal to your [Victories](../../Browse/rule/resource/victories.md).

> **The Auteur [Troubadour](../../Browse/class/troubadour.md)**
>
> Abilities like [Guest Star](../../Browse/feature/ability/troubadour/level-2/guest-star.md), [Missed Cue](../../Browse/feature/troubadour/level-3/missed-cue.md), and [Twist at the End](../../Browse/feature/ability/troubadour/level-2/twist-at-the-end.md) allow the auteur to rewrite bits of what happens in the battle by temporarily removing creatures from an encounter, bringing people back to life, or causing a new ally to appear. These abilities and features are no more powerful than any other, but they're narratively different from shooting rays of fire or swinging a sword.
>
> This is because, uniquely among all the [subclasses](../../Browse/rule/general/subclass.md) in *Draw Steel*, the auteur knows that the combat encounter playing out at your table is really a story being told sometime later, probably in a tavern.
>
> When the auteur uses these abilities, they are changing that story. They rewrite stories to make them more dramatic in the telling. What *actually* happened is a matter of some debate. Even the people who were there don't agree on exactly what took place. How people *remember* it is what's important!
>
> This is pretty weird, but also very fun. If it's too weird for you or your table, you could always interpret those abilities as a kind of magic. A school of conjuring that really does change the battlefield, which the auteur merely *flavors* as rewriting the story.

#### Kit {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.troubadour.level-1/kit"}

You can use and gain the benefits of a kit. See Chapter 6: [Kits](kits.md) for more information. (*Quick Build:* [Swashbuckler](../../Browse/kit/swashbuckler.md).)

#### Scene Partner {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.troubadour.level-1/scene-partner"}

Whenever you obtain a success on a [test](../../Browse/rule/test/test.md) to interact with an [NPC](../../Browse/rule/general/npc.md) using a skill from the [interpersonal group](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/interpersonal.md), you can form a bond with that [NPC](../../Browse/rule/general/npc.md). When you enter into a negotiation with a bonded [NPC](../../Browse/rule/general/npc.md), their patience increases by 1 (to a maximum of 5). Additionally, the first time during a negotiation that you personally make an argument that would increase a bonded [NPC](../../Browse/rule/general/npc.md)'s interest by 1, you instead increase their interest by 2 (to a maximum of 5).

You can have a number of bonds active equal to your level. When you form a bond with a new [NPC](../../Browse/rule/general/npc.md) that would exceed the limit, you must choose which of your active bonds to lose.

#### Routines {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.troubadour.level-1/routines"}

You enter every battle with a set of performance abilities at the ready. Performances are magical presentations (such as songs, dances, poems, or gymnastic feats) that your allies can participate in. These abilities have the Performance keyword. At the start of each [combat round](../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round.md), as long as you are not [dazed](../../Browse/condition/dazed.md), dead, or [surprised](../../Browse/rule/combat/surprised.md), you can either choose a new performance or maintain your current performance (no action required). Your performance lasts until you are unable to maintain it or until the end of the encounter.

You start off with the [Choreography](../../Browse/feature/ability/troubadour/level-1/choreography.md) and [Revitalizing Limerick](../../Browse/feature/ability/troubadour/level-1/revitalizing-limerick.md) performance abilities. Your choice of class act grants you additional performances.

##### Choreography {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.troubadour.level-1/choreography"}

One ally within [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) gains an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on the next [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) they make before the start of your next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).
- You weave a tale of high-stakes heroics. One ally within [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) gains 1 [surge](../../Browse/rule/resource/surge.md).
- You insult a foe where they're most vulnerable. One enemy within [distance](../../Browse/rule/combat/distance.md) takes a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) on the next [power roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll.md) they make before the end of their next [turn](../../Browse/rule/combat/turn.md).

**Spend 1 Drama:** You can choose two targets for the chosen effect.

#### Class Act Triggered Action {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.troubadour.level-1/class-act-triggered-action"}

Your [troubadour class act](../../Browse/feature/troubadour/level-1/troubadour-class-act.md) grants you a [triggered action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md), as shown on the Class Act [Triggered Actions](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md) table.

###### Class Act Triggered Action Table

| Class Act | [Triggered Action](../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action.md)       |
|-----------|------------------------|
| Auteur    | [Turnabout Is Fair Play](../../Browse/feature/ability/troubadour/level-1/turnabout-is-fair-play.md) |
| Duelist   | [Riposte](../../Browse/feature/ability/troubadour/level-1/riposte.md)                |
| Virtuoso  | [Harmonize](../../Browse/feature/ability/troubadour/level-1/harmonize.md)              |

###### Harmonize {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.troubadour.level-1/harmonize"}


*Give the chorus a little punch.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**      |   **Triggered** |
|-----------------|----------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 5** | **🎯 One ally** |

**Trigger:** The target uses an ability that targets only one enemy and costs 3 or fewer of their [Heroic Resource](../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource.md).

**Effect:** The target can choose one additional target for the triggering ability. Any damage dealt to the additional target is sonic damage.

**Spend 1+ Drama:** You can trigger this ability when a target uses an ability that has a [Heroic Resource](../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource.md) cost of 3 + each additional drama spent.

###### Riposte {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.troubadour.level-1/riposte"}


*"I'd have brought treats had I known I'd be fighting a dog."*

| **[Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md)**      |           **Triggered** |
|----------------|------------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) 1** | **🎯 Self or one ally** |

**Trigger:** The target takes damage from a [melee](../../Browse/rule/combat/melee.md) [strike](../../Browse/rule/combat/strike.md).

**Effect:** The target makes a [free strike](../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md) against the creature who made the triggering strike.

###### Turnabout Is Fair Play {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.troubadour.level-1/turnabout-is-fair-play"}


*All's fair in love and whatever.*

| **[Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md)**       |       **Triggered** |
|------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged.md) 10** | **🎯 One creature** |

**Trigger:** The target makes an [ability roll](../../Browse/rule/dice/ability-roll.md) that has an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md), a double [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md), a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md), or a double [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md).

**Effect:** An [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on the triggering roll becomes a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md), or a double [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) becomes an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md). A [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) becomes an [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md), or a double [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) becomes a [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md).

**Spend 3 Drama:** An [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) on the triggering roll becomes a double [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md), or a double [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md) is negated. A [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) becomes a double [edge](../../Browse/rule/dice/edge.md), or a double [bane](../../Browse/rule/dice/bane.md) is negated.
